title: Applied Hydrodynamics
description: This textbook treats Hydro- and Fluid Dynamics, the engineering science dealing with forces and energies generated by fluids in motion, playing a vital role in everyday life. Practical examples include the flow motion in the kitchen sink, the exhaust fan above the stove, and the air conditioning system in our home. When driving a car, the air flow around the vehicle body induces some drag which increases with the square of the car speed and contributes to excess fuel consumption. Engineering applications encompass fluid transport in pipes and canals, energy generation, environmental processes and transportation (cars, ships, aircrafts). This book deals with the topic of applied hydrodynamics. The lecture material is grouped into two complementary sections: ideal fluid flow and real fluid flow. The former deals with two- and possibly three-dimensional fluid motions that are not subject to boundary friction effects, while the latter considers the flow regions affected by boundary friction and turbulent shear. The lecture material is designed as an intermediate course in fluid dynamics for senior undergraduate and postgraduate students in Civil, Environmental, Hydraulic and Mechanical Engineering. It is supported by notes, applications, remarks and discussions in each chapter. Moreover a series of appendices is added, while some major homework assignments are developed at the end of the book, before the bibliographic references.
translatedDescription: Este libro de texto trata a Hydro- and Fluid Dynamics, la ciencia de ingeniería que trata con fuerzas y energías generadas por fluidos en movimiento, jugando un papel vital en la vida cotidiana. Ejemplos prácticos incluyen el movimiento de flujo en el fregadero de la cocina, el ventilador de escape sobre la estufa, y el sistema de aire acondicionado en nuestra casa. Al conducir un coche, el flujo de aire alrededor del cuerpo del vehículo induce una cierta arrastre que aumenta con la plaza de la velocidad del coche y contribuye al exceso de consumo de combustible. Las aplicaciones de ingeniería abarcan el transporte de fluidos en tuberías y canales, la generación de energía, los procesos ambientales y el transporte (carros, barcos, aeronaves). Este libro trata el tema de la hidrodinámica aplicada. El material de conferencias se agrupa en dos secciones complementarias: flujo de fluido ideal y flujo de fluido real. La primera se ocupa de los movimientos de fluidos bidimensionales y posiblemente tridimensionales que no están sujetos a efectos de fricción de límites, mientras que la segunda considera las regiones de flujo afectadas por la fricción de límites y el tirón turbulento. El material de conferencias está diseñado como un curso intermedio en dinámica de fluidos para estudiantes de grado y posgrado en Ingeniería Civil, Ambiental, Hidráulica y Mecánica. Está respaldada por notas, solicitudes, observaciones y debates en cada capítulo. Además se añade una serie de apéndices, mientras que algunas tareas importantes se desarrollan al final del libro, antes de las referencias bibliográficas.

title: Investigating the Human Genome: Insights into Human Variation and Disease Susceptibility
description:
Leading medical genetics scholar Moyra Smith reviews current and recent work in genetics and genomics to assess progress in understanding human variation and the pathogenesis of common and rare diseases in which genetics plays a role. Smith provides an exceptional overview of the most important biomedical progress arising from the greatly increased genetic information base generated by gene mapping and the sequencing of the complete Human Genome.

This book addresses into a wide spectrum of topics associated with human genetics and genomics, including:

Human origins; migrations and human population diversity gained though genomic analyses.

The complexities of psychiatric diseases that are influenced by genetics.

The pathogenesis of late-onset neurological diseases such as Alzheimer’s, Parkinsonism, and ALS.

Key aspects of protein misfolding.

Gene-environment interactions in DNA damage and repair and DNA instability.

Micro RNAs and mRNA translation.

Epigenetics.

New functions for old enzymes in cancer.

Smith ofrece un panorama excepcional del progreso biomédico más importante derivado de la base de información genética mucho mayor generada por el mapeo de genes y la secuenciación del genoma humano completo.

Este libro aborda un amplio espectro de temas asociados a la genética humana y la genómica, incluyendo:

Los orígenes humanos; las migraciones y la diversidad de la población humana se obtuvieron mediante análisis genómicos.

Las complejidades de las enfermedades psiquiátricas que están influenciadas por la genética.

La patogénesis de enfermedades neurológicas de aparición tardía como Alzheimer, Parkinsonism y ALS.

Aspectos clave de la malversación de proteínas.

Interacciones genética-ambiente en daño y reparación de ADN e inestabilidad de ADN.

Micro ARN y traducción mRNA.

Epigenética.

Nuevas funciones para las enzimas viejas en el cáncer.

description:

title: A Key for Identification of Rock-Forming Minerals in Thin Section
description:
Structured in the form of a dichotomous key, comparable to those widely used in botany, the mineral key provides an efficient and systematic approach to identifying rock-forming minerals in thin-section. This unique approach covers 150+ of the most commonly encountered rock-forming minerals, plus a few rarer but noteworthy ones. Illustrated in full colour, with 330+ high quality mineral photomicrographs from a worldwide collection of igneous, metamorphic, and sedimentary rocks, it also provides a comprehensive atlas of rock-forming minerals in thin-section.

Commencing with a brief introduction to mineral systems, and the properties of minerals in plane-polarised and cross-polarised light, the mineral key also includes line drawings, tables of mineral properties and an interference colour chart, to further aid mineral identification. To minimise the chance of misidentification, and enable less experienced petrologists to use the key with confidence, the key has been arranged to prioritise those properties that are most easily recognised.

Designed for simplicity and ease of use, it is primarily aimed at undergraduate and postgraduate students of mineralogy and petrology, but should also provide a valuable source of reference for all practising geologists dealing with rock thinsections and their interpretation.
translatedDescription:
Estructurado en forma de una clave dicotomosa, comparable a la utilizada ampliamente en la botánica, la clave mineral proporciona un enfoque eficiente y sistemático para identificar minerales formadores de roca en la sección delgada. Este enfoque único abarca 150+ de los minerales más comúnmente encontrados formando roca, además de algunos más raros pero notables. Ilustrado a todo color, con fotomicrógrafos minerales de alta calidad 330+ de una colección mundial de rocas ígneas, metamorfóricas y sedimentarias, también proporciona un atlas integral de minerales formadores de roca en la sección delgada.

Comenzando con una breve introducción a los sistemas minerales, y las propiedades de los minerales en la luz polarizada y multipolarizada plana, la clave mineral también incluye dibujos de líneas, tablas de propiedades minerales y un gráfico de color de interferencia, para ayudar a la identificación mineral. Para minimizar la posibilidad de la identificación errónea, y permitir que los petrólogos menos experimentados usen la clave con confianza, la clave se ha arreglado para priorizar las propiedades que son más fácilmente reconocidas.

Diseñado para la simplicidad y facilidad de uso, está dirigido principalmente a estudiantes de pregrado y posgrado de mineralogía y petrología, pero también debe proporcionar una valiosa fuente de referencia para todos los geólogos practicantes que se ocupan de las secciones del rock y su interpretación.

title: Jump Start Git
description:
Get a Jump Start on version control with Git today!

Most engineers we meet prefer Git over other distributed version control systems.

These systems let you store different versions of project files and directories, so you can roll back to an earlier one if something goes wrong. And since they're distributed, they smooth the path for dev team collaboration.

But what is it about Git that makes it mission-critical on so many web projects?

Spend just one weekend with this hands-on tutorial, and you'll know the answer.

Estos sistemas le permiten almacenar diferentes versiones de archivos de proyectos y directorios, para que pueda volver a uno anterior si algo sale mal. Y ya que están distribuidos, suavizan el camino para la colaboración del equipo dev.

Pero, ¿qué es lo de Git que lo convierte en misión crítica en tantos proyectos web?

Pasa un fin de semana con este tutorial práctico, y sabrás la respuesta.

title: The Essential Guide to HTML5 and CSS3 Web Design
description:
The Essential Guide to HTML5 and CSS3 Web Design has been fully revised from its critically acclaimed first edition, and updated to include all of the new features and best practices of HTML5 and CSS3. This book reveals all you'll need to design great web sites that are standards-compliant, usable, and aesthetically pleasing, but it won't overwhelm you with waffle, theory, or obscure details!

You will find The Essential Guide to HTML5 and CSS3 Web Design invaluable at any stage of your career, with its mixture of practical tutorials and reference material. Beginners will quickly pick up the basics, while more experienced web designers and developers will keep returning to the book again and again to read up on techniques they may not have used for a while, or to look up properties, attributes and other details. This book is destined to become a close friend, adopting a permanent place on your desk.

The Essential Guide to HTML5 and CSS3 Web Design starts off with a brief introduction to the web and web design, before diving straight in to HTML5 and CSS3 basics, reusing code, and other best practices you can adopt. The book then focuses on the most important areas of a successful web site: typography, images, navigation, tables, layouts, forms and feedback (including ready-made PHP scripts) and browser quirks, hacks and bugs.

The Essential Guide to HTML5 and CSS3 Web Design is completely up-to-date, covering support of the newest standards in all the latest browsers, including IE 9 and Firefox 4. The last chapter of the book provides several case studies to dissect and learn from, including all the most popular web site archetypes—a blog, a store front, a corporate home page, and an online gallery. You'll also appreciate several detailed reference appendices covering CSS, HTML, color references, entities, and more—any details you need to look up will be close at hand.

title: Adventures in Minecraft, 2nd Edition
description:
Learn valuable programming skills while building your own Minecraft adventure!

If you love playing Minecraft and want to learn how to code and create your own mods, this book was designed just for you. Working within the game itself, you'll learn to set up and run your own local Minecraft server, interact with the game on PC, Mac and Raspberry Pi, and develop Python programming skills that apply way beyond Minecraft. You'll learn how to use coordinates, how to change the player’s position, how to create and delete blocks and how to check when a block has been hit.

The adventures aren't limited to the virtual – you'll also learn how to connect Minecraft to a BBC micro:bit so your Minecraft world can sense and control objects in the real world! The companion website gives you access to tutorial videos to make sure you understand the book, starter kits to make setup simple, completed code files, and badges to collect for your accomplishments. Written specifically for young people by professional Minecraft geeks, this fun, easy-to-follow guide helps you expand Minecraft for more exciting adventures, and put your personal stamp on the world you create. Your own Minecraft world will be unlike anyone else's on the planet, and you'll pick up programming skills that will serve you for years to come on other devices and projects. Among other things, you will:

Write Minecraft programs in Python® on your Mac®, PC or Raspberry Pi®
Build houses, structures, and make a 3D duplicating machine
Build intelligent objects and program an alien invasion
Build huge 2D and 3D structures like spheres and pyramids
Build a custom game controller using a BBC micro:bit™
Plan and write a complete interactive arena game

Adventures in Minecraft teaches you how to make your favourite game even better, while you learn to program by customizing your Minecraft journey.

title: SVG Essentials
description:
Scalable Vector Graphics -- or SVG -- is the new XML-based graphics standard from the W3C that will enable Web documents to be smaller, faster and more interactive. J. David Eisenberg's insightful book takes you through the ins and outs of SVG, beginning with basics needed to create simple line drawings and then moving through more complicated features like filters, transformations, and integration with Java, Perl, and XSLT.Unlike GIFs, JPEGs or PNGs (which are bitmapped), SVG images are both resolution- and device-independent, so that they can scale up or down to fit proportionally into any size display or any Internet device -- from PDAs to large office monitors and high-resolution printers. Smaller than bitmapped files and faster to download, SVG images can be rendered with different CSS styles for each environment. They work well across a range of available bandwidths.SVG makes it possible for designers to escape the constant need to update graphics by hand or use custom code to generate bitmap images. And while SVG was created with the Web in mind, the language has a variety of other uses. SVG greatly simplifies tasks like:

Creating web sites whose graphics reflect the content of the page, changing automatically if the content changes
Generating graphs and charts from information stored in a wide variety of sources
Exchanging detailed drawings, from architectural plans to CAD layouts to project management diagrams
Creating diagrams that users can explore by zooming in and panning around
Generating bitmap images for use in older browsers using simple automatable templates
Managing graphics that support multiple languages or translations
Creating complex animation
By focusing sharply on the markup at the foundation of SVG, SVG Essentials gives you a solid base on which to create your own custom tools. Explanations of key technical tools -- like XML, matrix math, and scripting -- are included as appendices, along with a reference to the SVG vocabulary.Whether you're a graphic designer in search of new tools or a programmer dealing with the complex task of creating and managing graphics, SVG Essentials provides you with the means to take advantage of SVG.

title: ScreenOS Cookbook

Scores of recipes address a wide range of security issues, provide step-by-step solutions, and include discussions of why the recipes work, so you can easily set up and keep ScreenOS systems on track.ScreenOS Cookbook gives you real-world fixes, techniques, and configurations that save time -- not hypothetical situations out of a textbook. The book comes directly from the experience of engineers who have seen and fixed every conceivable ScreenOS network topology, from small branch office firewalls to appliances for large core enterprise and government, to the heavy duty protocol driven service provider network. Its easy-to-follow format enables you to find the topic and specific recipe you need right away and match it to your network and security issue.Topics include:

Configuring and managing ScreenOS firewalls

Interfaces, Zones, and Virtual Routers

title: Pro Android Web Apps: Develop for Android Using HTML5, CSS3 & JavaScript
description:
Developing applications for Android and other mobile devices using web technologies is now well within reach. When the capabilities of HTML5 are combined with CSS3 and Javascript, web application developers have an opportunity to develop compelling mobile applications using familiar tools. Not only is it possible to build mobile web apps that feel as good as native apps, but to also write an application once and have it run a variety of different devices.

While the HTML5 specification is still evolving, there is a lot that can be used right now to build mobile web apps. Mobile web apps are now starting to provide many of the features that were once only available to native-language-based Apps in Java, Objective-C, etc. Pro Android Web Apps teaches developers already familiar with web application development, how to code and structure a web app for use on the Android mobile platform.

Understand both the why and how of mobile web app development, focusing on the Android platform.

Learn how to structure mobile web apps through a number of practical, real-world application examples.

Discover what cloud platforms such as Google AppEngine have to offer Android web apps, for both hosting web apps and providing device to cloud data synchronization solutions.

Get a real picture of the status of HTML5 on Android and other mobile devices, including some things to watch out for when building your own applications.

Understand the capabilities of the web application stack, and how to complement those with native bridging frameworks such as PhoneGap to access native features of the device.

Gain an understanding of the different UI frameworks that are available for building mobile web apps.

Learn how to include mapping and leverage Location Based Services in mobile web apps to create engaging mobile experiences.

Enable social integration with your Android web app and gain access to millions of potential users.

After reading this book, you will not only have a greater understanding of the world of web apps on Android, but also how to leverage additional tools and frameworks to increase the reach of your mobile web apps. Additionally, through the practical samples in the book you will have been given solid exposure of where both the opportunities and challenges lie when building mobile apps the web way.

No sólo es posible crear aplicaciones web móviles que se sientan tan bien como aplicaciones nativas, sino también escribir una aplicación una vez y tener que ejecutar una variedad de dispositivos diferentes.

Mientras la especificación HTML5 sigue evolucionando, hay mucho que se puede utilizar ahora mismo para crear aplicaciones web móviles. Las aplicaciones web móviles están empezando a proporcionar muchas de las características que sólo estaban disponibles en Java, Objective-C, etc. Pro Android Web Apps enseña a los desarrolladores ya familiarizados con el desarrollo de aplicaciones web, cómo codificar y estructurar una aplicación web para su uso en la plataforma móvil Android.

Entender tanto el por qué como el desarrollo de aplicaciones web móviles, centrándose en la plataforma Android.

Aprende a estructurar aplicaciones web móviles a través de varios ejemplos prácticos de aplicaciones en el mundo real.

Descubra qué plataformas de nube como Google AppEngine tienen que ofrecer aplicaciones web de Android, tanto para acoger aplicaciones web como para proporcionar dispositivo a soluciones de sincronización de datos en la nube.

Obtenga una imagen real del estado de HTML5 en Android y otros dispositivos móviles, incluyendo algunas cosas para tener cuidado al construir sus propias aplicaciones.

Entender las capacidades de la pila de aplicaciones web, y cómo complementar aquellas con marcos nativos como PhoneGap para acceder a las características nativas del dispositivo.

Obtenga una comprensión de los diferentes marcos de interfaz de usuario que están disponibles para la construcción de aplicaciones web móviles.

Aprenda a incluir mapeo y apalancamiento Servicios basados en la ubicación en aplicaciones web móviles para crear experiencias móviles atractivas.

Permitir la integración social con su aplicación web Android y obtener acceso a millones de usuarios potenciales.

Después de leer este libro, no sólo tendrá una mayor comprensión del mundo de las aplicaciones web en Android, sino también cómo aprovechar herramientas y marcos adicionales para aumentar el alcance de sus aplicaciones web móviles. Además, a través de las muestras prácticas en el libro se le ha dado una exposición sólida de donde tanto las oportunidades como los desafíos se encuentran al construir aplicaciones móviles de la manera web.

title: Contemporary Ergonomics and Human Factors 2013
description: The broad and developing scope of ergonomics - the application of scientific knowledge to improve people’s interaction with products, systems and environments - has been illustrated for 27 years by the books which make up the Contemporary Ergonomics series.This book presents the proceedings of the international conference on Contemporary Ergonomics and Human Factors 2013. In addition to being the leading event in the UK that features ergonomics and human factors across all sectors, this is also the annual conference of the Institute of Ergonomics & Human Factors. Individual papers provide insight into current practice, present new research findings and form an invaluable reference source. The volumes provide a fast track for the publication of suitable papers from international contributors, with papers being subject to peer review since 2009. A wide range of topics are covered in these proceedings including human computer interaction, standards, accessibility, work & wellbeing, design, transport, safety culture, green ergonomics, healthcare, human cognition, biomechanics, crowd behaviour and the systems approach. As well as being of interest to mainstream ergonomists and human factors specialists, Contemporary Ergonomics and Human Factors will appeal to all those who are concerned with people's interactions with their working and leisure environment including designers, manufacturing and production engineers, health and safety specialists, occupational, applied and industrial psychologists, and applied physiologists.

Este libro presenta las deliberaciones de la conferencia internacional sobre la ergonomía contemporánea y los factores humanos 2013. Los documentos individuales proporcionan información sobre la práctica actual, presentan nuevos hallazgos de investigación y forman una fuente de referencia inestimable. Los volúmenes proporcionan una vía rápida para la publicación de documentos adecuados de los contribuyentes internacionales, con documentos sujetos a revisión por pares desde 2009. En estos procedimientos se abordan una amplia gama de temas, como la interacción con la computadora humana, las normas, la accesibilidad, el trabajo y el bienestar, el diseño, el transporte, la cultura de seguridad, la ergonomía verde, la salud, la cognición humana, la biomecánica, el comportamiento de la multitud y el enfoque de los sistemas. Además de ser de interés para incorporar ergonomistas y especialistas en factores humanos, la Ergonomía contemporánea y los factores humanos atraerán a todos aquellos que se ocupan de las interacciones de las personas con su entorno de trabajo y ocio, incluyendo diseñadores, ingenieros de fabricación y producción, especialistas en salud y seguridad, psicólogos ocupacionales, aplicados e industriales, y fisiólogos aplicados.

title: Dimensional Analysis and Similarity in Fluid Mechanics
description:
Dimensional analysis is the basis for the determination of laws that allow the experimental results obtained on a model to be transposed to the fluid system at full scale (a prototype). The similarity in fluid mechanics then allows for better redefinition of the analysis by removing dimensionless elements.

This book deals with these two tools, with a focus on the Rayleigh method and the Vaschy-Buckingham method. It deals with the homogeneity of the equations and the conversion between the systems of units SI and CGS, and presents the dimensional analysis approach, before addressing the similarity of flows.

Dimensional Analysis and Similarity in Fluid Mechanics proposes a scale model and presents numerous exercises combining these two methods. It is accessible to students from their first year of a bachelor's degree.
translatedDescription:
El análisis dimensional es la base para la determinación de leyes que permiten que los resultados experimentales obtenidos en un modelo se transpongan al sistema de fluidos a toda escala (un prototipo). La similitud en la mecánica de fluidos permite entonces una mejor redefinición del análisis eliminando elementos sin dimensión.

Este libro trata de estas dos herramientas, con un enfoque en el método Rayleigh y el método Vaschy-Buckingham. Se ocupa de la homogeneidad de las ecuaciones y la conversión entre los sistemas de unidades SI y CGS, y presenta el enfoque de análisis dimensional, antes de abordar la similitud de los flujos.

Dimensional Analysis and Similarity in Fluid Mechanics propone un modelo de escala y presenta numerosos ejercicios que combinan estos dos métodos. Es accesible para estudiantes desde su primer año de licenciatura.

description:

About This Book

An applied guide exploring web application development with Bootstrap 4

Learn responsive web design and discover how to build mobile-ready websites with ease

Become an expert in Bootstrap framework, and speed up frontend development and prototyping through real-life examples

Who This Book Is For

If you’re a web developer with little or no knowledge of Bootstrap, then this course is for you. The course offers support for version 4 of Bootstrap; however, it will offer support for version 3 as well. So, you will be ready for whatever comes your way. Prior knowledge of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript is expected.

What You Will Learn

Discover how to use Bootstrap's components and elements, and customize them for your own projects

Understand the framework's usage in the best way with the recommended development patterns

Use Sass to customize your existing themes

Apply the Bootstrap mobile-first grid system and add responsiveness and aesthetic touches to image elements

Customize the behavior and features of Bootstrap’s jQuery Plugins extensively

Style various types of content and learn how to build a page’s layout from scratch by applying the power of Bootstrap 4

Work with content, such as tables and figures

Bootstrap framework's ease-of-use (along with its cross-browser compatibility, support for mobile user interfaces, and responsive web design capabilities) makes it an essential building block for any modern web application.

With the first module, plunge into the Bootstrap frontend framework with the help of examples that will illustrate the use of each element and component in a proper way. You will get a better understanding of what is happening and where you want to reach. Also, you will gain confidence with the framework and develop some very common examples using Bootstrap. All these examples are explained step by step and in depth.

The second module is a comprehensive tutorial; we'll teach you everything that you need to know to start building websites with Bootstrap 4 in a practical way. You'll learn about build tools such as Node, Grunt, and many others. You'll also discover the principles of mobile-first design in order to ensure that your pages can fit any screen size and meet responsive requirements. Learn Bootstrap's grid system and base CSS to ensure that your designs are robust and that your development process is speedy and efficient.

Right from the first chapter of the third module, you'll delve into building a customized Bootstrap website from scratch. Get to grips with Bootstrap's key features and quickly discover the various ways in which Bootstrap can help you develop web interfaces. Once you reach the final pages of this book, you should have mastered the framework's ins and outs, and should be building highly customizable and optimized web interfaces.

The course will enable you to rapidly build elegant, powerful, and responsive interfaces for professional-level web pages using Bootstrap 4.

This Learning Path combines some of the best that Packt has to offer in one complete, curated package. It includes content from the following Packt products:

Style and approach

title: Introduction to Storage Area Networks
description:
The superabundance of data that is created by today's businesses is making storage a strategic investment priority for companies of all sizes. As storage takes precedence, the following major initiatives emerge:

Flatten and converge your network: IBM® takes an open, standards-based approach to implement the latest advances in the flat, converged data center network designs of today. IBM Storage solutions enable clients to deploy a high-speed, low-latency Unified Fabric Architecture.

Optimize and automate virtualization: Advanced virtualization awareness reduces the cost and complexity of deploying physical and virtual data center infrastructure.

Simplify management: IBM data center networks are easy to deploy, maintain, scale, and virtualize, delivering the foundation of consolidated operations for dynamic infrastructure management.

Storage is no longer an afterthought. Too much is at stake. Companies are searching for more ways to efficiently manage expanding volumes of data, and to make that data accessible throughout the enterprise. This demand is propelling the move of storage into the network. Also, the increasing complexity of managing large numbers of storage devices and vast amounts of data is driving greater business value into software and services.

With current estimates of the amount of data to be managed and made available increasing at 60% each year, this outlook is where a storage area network (SAN) enters the arena. SANs are the leading storage infrastructure for the global economy of today. SANs offer simplified storage management, scalability, flexibility, and availability; and improved data access, movement, and backup.

Welcome to the cognitive era.

The smarter data center with the improved economics of IT can be achieved by connecting servers and storage with a high-speed and intelligent network fabric. A smarter data center that hosts IBM Storage solutions can provide an environment that is smarter, faster, greener, open, and easy to manage.

This IBM® Redbooks® publication provides an introduction to SAN and Ethernet networking, and how these networks help to achieve a smarter data center. This book is intended for people who are not very familiar with IT, or who are just starting out in the IT world.
translatedDescription:
La superabundancia de los datos creados por las empresas actuales está haciendo del almacenamiento una prioridad estratégica de inversión para las empresas de todos los tamaños. A medida que el almacenamiento tiene prioridad, emergen las siguientes iniciativas importantes:

Aplanar y converger su red: IBM® adopta un enfoque abierto y basado en estándares para implementar los últimos avances en los diseños de red de centros de datos planos y convergentes de hoy. IBM Las soluciones de almacenamiento permiten a los clientes desplegar una arquitectura de tela unificada de alta velocidad y baja latencia.

Optimizar y automatizar la virtualización: La conciencia de virtualización avanzada reduce el coste y la complejidad de implementar infraestructuras de centros de datos físicos y virtuales.

Simplifique la gestión: las redes de centros de datos IBM son fáciles de implementar, mantener, escalar y virtualizar, proporcionando la base de operaciones consolidadas para la gestión dinámica de infraestructuras.

El almacenamiento ya no es un pensamiento posterior. Demasiado está en juego. Las empresas están buscando más maneras de gestionar eficientemente los volúmenes de datos en expansión y hacer que los datos sean accesibles en toda la empresa. Esta demanda impulsa el traslado de almacenamiento a la red. Además, la creciente complejidad de gestionar un gran número de dispositivos de almacenamiento y vastas cantidades de datos está impulsando un mayor valor comercial en software y servicios.

Con estimaciones actuales de la cantidad de datos que se gestionarán y se pondrán a disposición cada año en un 60%, esta perspectiva es donde una red de área de almacenamiento (SAN) entra en la arena. SANs es la principal infraestructura de almacenamiento para la economía mundial de hoy. SANs ofrecen una gestión simplificada de almacenamiento, escalabilidad, flexibilidad y disponibilidad; y un mejor acceso a los datos, movimiento y respaldo.

Bienvenidos a la era cognitiva.

El centro de datos más inteligente con la economía mejorada de la TI se puede lograr mediante la conexión de servidores y almacenamiento con un tejido de red inteligente y de alta velocidad. Un centro de datos más inteligente que alberga soluciones de almacenamiento IBM puede proporcionar un entorno más inteligente, rápido, más verde, abierto y fácil de manejar.

Esta publicación IBM® Redbooks® ofrece una introducción a las redes SAN y Ethernet, y cómo estas redes ayudan a lograr un centro de datos más inteligente. Este libro está destinado a personas que no están muy familiarizadas con IT, o que están empezando en el mundo de TI.

title: Google Daydream VR Cookbook: Building Games and Apps with Google Daydream and Unity, First Edition
description:
The Complete, Up-to-Date Guide to Building AR and VR Games

 

Google’s new ARCore and Daydream VR platforms enable you to deliver advanced augmented and virtual reality games and apps on a wide spectrum of modern Android devices. Now for the first time, there’s a comprehensive deep dive into both ARCore and Daydream for every Android developer and designer. Multi-award-winning AR/VR developer Sam Keene takes a hands-on approach, leading you through all aspects of the ARCore and Daydream frameworks and SDKs, with step-by-step tutorials and advice for building pro-quality AR/VR games and apps.

 

Keene presents his material as a cookbook of recipes to get you up and running with VR/AR development as fast and as painlessly as possible. The recipes in most chapters start by assembling the essential building blocks, which are pieced together to create something larger. You are then free to take these building blocks and turn them into your own creation.Keene also provides an extensive library of downloadable, up-to-the-minute ARCore and Daydream code to jumpstart your project. In addition, he takes you through crucial UX design principles and best practices learned from building large scale VR and AR apps at Google.Google Daydream VR Cookbook shows you how to:

Install and explore the Google Daydream development tools
Master basic and advanced Daydream Controller techniques
Implement intuitive VR user interfaces
Integrate audio, video, and realistic physics into your VR games
Install and explore the ARCore SDK and development tools
Learn how to build AR apps that solve real user needs
Master AR game development using ARCore
Optimize VR and AR game performance

Whether you are a software developer, UX professional, visual designer, beginner, or you come from a different design field, this book is a great practical introduction to VR and AR.

Guía completa para construir juegos de AR y VR



Las nuevas plataformas ARCore y Daydream VR de Google le permiten ofrecer juegos y aplicaciones avanzadas de realidad aumentada y virtual en un amplio espectro de dispositivos Android modernos. Ahora por primera vez, hay una inmersión profunda completa en ARCore y Daydream para cada desarrollador y diseñador de Android. Sam Keene, desarrollador de AR/VR múltiples, toma un enfoque práctico, lo que le lleva a través de todos los aspectos de los marcos ARCore y Daydream y SDKs, con tutoriales paso a paso y consejos para construir juegos y aplicaciones de AR/VR de calidad.



Keene presenta su material como un libro de recetas para levantarte y correr con el desarrollo VR/AR lo más rápido y sin dolor posible. Las recetas en la mayoría de los capítulos comienzan por montar los bloques de construcción esenciales, que se unen para crear algo más grande. Entonces eres libre de tomar estos bloques de construcción y convertirlos en tu propia creación. Keene también ofrece una extensa biblioteca de código ARCore y Daydream descargable y actualizado para iniciar su proyecto. Además, él te lleva a través de principios cruciales de diseño UX y mejores prácticas aprendidas de la construcción de aplicaciones VR y AR a gran escala en Google. Google Daydream VR Cookbook le muestra cómo:

Instalar y explorar las herramientas de desarrollo de Google Daydream
Técnicas básicas y avanzadas de control de sueño
Implementar interfaces de usuario VR intuitivas
Integrar audio, vídeo y física realista en tus juegos VR
Instalar y explorar el SDK y herramientas de desarrollo ARCore
Aprender a crear aplicaciones AR que solucionen necesidades reales de los usuarios
Master AR desarrollo del juego utilizando ARCore
Optimize VR y AR juego rendimiento

Si usted es un desarrollador de software, profesional UX, diseñador visual, principiante, o viene de un campo de diseño diferente, este libro es una gran introducción práctica a VR y AR.

title: Gitolite Essentials
description:
Gitolite Essentials serves as a compact yet comprehensive guide to mastering secure access control for Git repositories using Gitolite. Through step-by-step chapters, this book walks you through managing users and repositories efficiently and securely, making it accessible for learners with basic Git experience.

What this Book will help me do

Understand the core functionalities of Gitolite and why it is used for repository access control.
Learn how to install and configure Gitolite for your Git servers.
Gain the ability to set up secure user and repository access policies.
Develop skills to audit and troubleshoot access control configurations in Gitolite.
Discover advanced use cases and customization options to optimize Gitolite for specific needs.

Author(s)

Sitaram Chamarty, the author of Gitolite Essentials, is an experienced systems programmer and has been involved deeply with Git and access control systems. As the creator of Gitolite, he brings hands-on expertise and insider knowledge, presenting it in an approachable and practical way. Sitaram takes pride in demystifying complex topics to empower IT and development professionals.

Who is it for?

This book is ideal for developers, system administrators, and tech enthusiasts who manage Git repositories and require precise control over user access. Readers are expected to have basic knowledge of Git and general server administration. If you aim to secure and streamline your repository management process, this is the guide for you. Perfect for those transitioning to Gitolite or seeking to enhance their Git server skills.

Lo que este libro me ayudará a hacer

Comprenda las funcionalidades básicas de Gitolite y por qué se utiliza para el control de acceso al repositorio.
Aprende cómo instalar y configurar Gitolite para tus servidores Git.
Obtenga la capacidad de establecer políticas seguras de acceso al usuario y al repositorio.
Desarrollar habilidades para auditar y solucionar problemas las configuraciones de control de acceso en Gitolite.
Descubra casos de uso avanzado y opciones de personalización para optimizar Gitolite para necesidades específicas.

Autor(s)

Sitaram Chamarty, autor de Gitolite Essentials, es un programador de sistemas experimentado y ha estado involucrado profundamente con Git y sistemas de control de acceso. Sitaram se enorgullece de la desmitificación de temas complejos para empoderar a profesionales de TI y desarrollo.

¿Para quién es?

Este libro es ideal para desarrolladores, administradores de sistemas y entusiastas de tecnología que administran los repositorios Git y requieren un control preciso sobre el acceso de los usuarios. Se espera que los lectores tengan conocimientos básicos de Git y administración general del servidor. Si usted busca asegurar y agilizar su proceso de gestión de repositorios, esta es la guía para usted. Perfecto para aquellos que pasan a Gitolite o buscan mejorar sus habilidades de servidor Git.

title: Learn Unity For 2D Game Development
description:
2D games are everywhere, from mobile devices and websites to game consoles and PCs. Timeless and popular, 2D games represent a substantial segment of the games market.

In Learn Unity for 2D Game Development, targeted at both game development newcomers and established developers, experienced game developer Alan Thorn shows you how to use the powerful Unity engine to create fun and imaginative 2D games.

Written in clear and accessible language, Learn Unity for 2D Game Development will show you how to set up a step-by-step 2D workflow in Unity, how to build and import textures, how to configure and work with cameras, how to establish pixel-perfect ratios, and all of this so you can put that infrastructure to work in a real, playable game. Then the final chapters show you how to put what you've already made to work in creating a card-matching game, plus you'll learn how to optimize your game for mobile devices.
translatedDescription:
Los juegos 2D están en todas partes, desde dispositivos móviles y sitios web a consolas de juego y PCs. Atemporal y popular, los juegos 2D representan un segmento sustancial del mercado de juegos.

En Learn Unity for 2D Game Development, dirigido tanto a los recién llegados de desarrollo del juego como a los desarrolladores establecidos, el desarrollador experimentado del juego Alan Thorn le muestra cómo utilizar el poderoso motor Unity para crear divertidos e imaginativos juegos 2D.

Escrito en lenguaje claro y accesible, Aprende Unity for 2D Game Development te mostrará cómo configurar un flujo de trabajo 2D paso a paso en Unity, cómo construir e importar texturas, cómo configurar y trabajar con cámaras, cómo establecer ratios de píxel perfecto, y todo esto para que puedas poner esa infraestructura para trabajar en un juego real y jugable. Luego los capítulos finales te muestran cómo poner lo que ya has hecho para trabajar en la creación de un juego de cartas, además aprenderás a optimizar tu juego para dispositivos móviles.

title: Analytical Geometry
description: Designed to meet the requirements of undergraduate students, Analytical Geometry: 2D and 3D deals with the theoretical as well as the practical aspects of the subject. Equal emphasis has been given to both 2D as well as 3D geometry. The book follows a systematic approach with adequate examples for better understanding of the concepts.

Se ha dado igual énfasis a la geometría 2D y 3D. El libro sigue un enfoque sistemático con ejemplos adecuados para comprender mejor los conceptos.

title: Architectural Visualization in Unreal Engine 5
description:
Master the art and science of architectural visualization with Unreal Engine 5 using this complete guide. With detailed walkthroughs and practical exercises, you'll learn how to create photorealistic 3D visualizations that stand out. Develop the skills to harness UE5's advanced lighting, materials, and real-time rendering capabilities tailored for architectural projects.

What this Book will help me do

Learn to import and optimize assets for high-quality visualization workflows.
Master advanced lighting strategies to enhance realism and immersion in architectural designs.
Create interactive scenes using blueprints to add dynamic features to your visualizations.
Understand how to use the material editor for creating bespoke textures and details.
Optimize scenes for efficient real-time viewing and high-performance rendering.

Author(s)

Ludovico Palmeri is a seasoned expert in architectural visualization and Unreal Engine technology. Combining years of experience with a passion for teaching, Palmeri provides insights and techniques catered to both newcomers and seasoned professionals in the field. His approachable methodology demystifies complex concepts into actionable steps.

Who is it for?

This book is perfect for CG-ArchViz artists, architects, and environment artists looking to leverage real-time visualization techniques using Unreal Engine 5. Ideal for those familiar with 3D modeling and Unreal Engine basics, this guide helps advance your understanding and capabilities in creating immersive architectural visualizations.

Con pasos detallados y ejercicios prácticos, aprenderás a crear visualizaciones fotorrealistas en 3D que se destacan. Desarrollar las habilidades para aprovechar las capacidades avanzadas de iluminación, materiales y renderización en tiempo real de la UE5 adaptadas para proyectos arquitectónicos.

title: Vulkan Cookbook
description:
"Vulkan Cookbook" is a comprehensive recipe-based guide designed for developers looking to master the Vulkan graphics API. The book brings you from the basics of creating Vulkan instances and devices, to advanced topics such as command buffers, GLSL shaders, and sophisticated rendering techniques, making it a valuable resource for GPU programming.

What this Book will help me do

Master the process of creating and managing Vulkan swap chains for graphics presentations.
Develop expertise in working with buffers, images, and memory management within Vulkan.
Learn to implement Vulkan's advanced rendering techniques like tessellation, texturing, and lighting for enhanced graphics.
Gain proficiency with shader programming in GLSL for creating efficient Vulkan pipelines.
Set up efficient and optimized rendering pipelines utilizing Vulkan's pipeline and pass systems.

Author(s)

The author, Pawel Lapinski, is an expert in computer graphics and GPU programming, known for his deep understanding of the Vulkan API and modern graphics techniques. With years of experience in the field and a passion for teaching, Pawel excels in providing practical knowledge and cultivating understanding in complex systems like Vulkan.

Who is it for?

This book is designed for developers with a foundational understanding of languages like C or C++ and some background in graphics programming. It is also a great resource for OpenGL developers transitioning to Vulkan. The reader should have a willingness to explore low-level programming concepts to achieve high technical performance and results.

El libro te lleva de los fundamentos de la creación de instancias y dispositivos Vulkan, a temas avanzados como amortiguadores de comandos, sombreadores GLSL y técnicas de renderización sofisticadas, por lo que es un recurso valioso para la programación de GPU.

Lo que este libro me ayudará a hacer

Domine el proceso de creación y gestión de cadenas de intercambio Vulkan para presentaciones gráficas.
Desarrollar experiencia en trabajar con amortiguadores, imágenes y gestión de memoria dentro de Vulkan.
Aprende a implementar las técnicas avanzadas de renderización de Vulkan como tessellation, texturing e iluminación para gráficos mejorados.
Gain proficiency with shadowr programming in GLSL for creating efficient Vulkan pipelines.
Configuración de tuberías de renderización eficientes y optimizados utilizando los sistemas de tuberías y pases de Vulkan.

Este libro está diseñado para desarrolladores con una comprensión fundamental de idiomas como C o C++ y algunos antecedentes en programación gráfica. El lector debería estar dispuesto a explorar conceptos de programación de bajo nivel para lograr un alto rendimiento técnico y resultados.

title: Firewalls Don't Stop Dragons: A Step-by-Step Guide to Computer Security and Privacy for Non-Techies
description:
Rely on this practical, comprehensive guide to significantly improve your cyber safety and data privacy. This book was written expressly for regular, everyday people -- though even technically savvy readers will find many useful tips here. This book contains everything you need to protect yourself-step by step, without judgment, and with as little jargon as possible. 
Protecting your digital domain is much like defending a medieval castle. Wide moats, towering walls and trained guards provide defense in depth, safeguarding the people and property within against the most common threats. But attempting to dragon-proof your castle would be counterproductive and costly. The goal of this book is to keep your devices and data safe from the most likely and impactful hazards - not a targeted attack by the NSA. Like wearing seat belts and sunscreen in the real world, there are dozens of simple, effective precautions we need to take in the virtual world. 
Author Carey Parker has structured this book to give you maximum benefit with minimum effort. If you just want to know what you need to do, each chapter includes a detailed checklist of expert tips. But the book also explains why you need to do these things, using entertaining analogies and straightforward explanations. This revised and expanded fifth edition includes: 
Updated for Windows 11, macOS 13 (Ventura), iOS 16 and Android 13. 
Updated recommendations for most secure and private products. 
Over 200 tips with complete step-by-step instructions and screenshots. 
What You Will Learn 
Maximize your computer and smartphone security. 
Minimize your vulnerabilities and data footprint. 
Solve your password problems and use two-factor authentication. 
Browse the web safely and confidently with a secure, private browser. 
Shop and bank online with maximum security and peace of mind. 
Defend against identity theft, ransomware and online scams. 
Safeguard your children online, at home and in school. 
Block online tracking, data mining and malicious online ads. 
Send files and messages with end-to-end encryption. 
Secure your home network and keep your smart devices from spying on you. 
Create automated backups of all your devices. 
Learn how to deal with account hacks, data. breaches and viruses. 
Understand how computers, the internet, VPNs and encryption really work 
And much more!

Confíe en esta guía práctica y completa para mejorar significativamente su seguridad cibernética y privacidad de datos. Este libro fue escrito expresamente para gente regular y cotidiana, aunque incluso los lectores técnicamente sabios encontrarán muchos consejos útiles aquí. Este libro contiene todo lo que necesitas para protegerte paso a paso, sin juicio, y con la menor jerga posible.
Proteger su dominio digital es como defender un castillo medieval. Grandes fogones, torrentes paredes y guardias entrenados proporcionan defensa en profundidad, salvaguardando al pueblo y la propiedad dentro de las amenazas más comunes. Pero intentar a prueba de dragón su castillo sería contraproducente y costoso. El objetivo de este libro es mantener sus dispositivos y datos seguros de los peligros más probables e impactantes - no un ataque dirigido por la NSA. Como llevar cinturón de seguridad y protector solar en el mundo real, hay docenas de precauciones simples y eficaces que necesitamos tomar en el mundo virtual.
Autor Carey Parker ha estructurado este libro para darle el máximo beneficio con mínimo esfuerzo. Si sólo quieres saber lo que necesitas hacer, cada capítulo incluye una lista detallada de consejos de expertos. Pero el libro también explica por qué necesitas hacer estas cosas, usando analogías entretenidas y explicaciones directas. Esta quinta edición revisada y ampliada incluye:
Actualizado para Windows 11, macOS 13 (Ventura), iOS 16 y Android 13.
Recomendaciones actualizadas para productos más seguros y privados.
Más de 200 consejos con instrucciones completas paso a paso y capturas de pantalla.
Qué aprenderás
Maximice su seguridad informática y smartphone.
Minimice sus vulnerabilidades y huella de datos.
Resolver sus problemas de contraseña y utilizar la autenticación de dos factores.
Examine la web de forma segura y segura con un navegador privado seguro.
Tienda y banco en línea con máxima seguridad y paz mental.
Defender contra robo de identidad, ransomware y estafas en línea.
Salvaguarda a tus hijos en línea, en casa y en la escuela.
Bloquear el seguimiento en línea, la minería de datos y anuncios en línea maliciosos.
Enviar archivos y mensajes con encriptación de extremo a extremo.
Asegúrate de tu red de hogar y evita que tus dispositivos inteligentes te espien.
Cree copias de seguridad automatizadas de todos sus dispositivos.
Aprenda cómo lidiar con hacks de cuenta, datos. Violaciones y virus.
Comprender cómo funcionan las computadoras, Internet, VPN y cifrado
¡Y mucho más!

title: Building RESTful Web services with Go
description:
Discover how to effectively build scalable, RESTful APIs using the Go programming language. This book introduces you to the architecture and design principles behind RESTful web services and equips you with the practical knowledge to implement powerful APIs that meet real-world demands. From using the Gin framework to incorporating advanced features like authentication and scalability, you'll gain hands-on expertise.

What this Book will help me do

Master the design and implementation of RESTful APIs using Go.
Leverage the Gin framework to simplify service routing and middleware.
Implement secure authentication mechanisms such as OAuth 2.
Build a client library to consume REST APIs and conduct unit testing.
Scale your applications with microservices and enhance performance.

Author(s)

None Yellavula is an experienced software developer with in-depth knowledge of building modern web applications. With a passion for backend technologies and API design, None has extensively worked with the Go programming language in high-performance application development. The friendly and practical approach taken in this book reflects none's dedication to educating developers.

Who is it for?

This book is ideal for developers with basic Go programming knowledge who want to learn to design and deploy RESTful APIs. Intended for software engineers, developers, and tech enthusiasts, it helps readers who aim to create scalable web services. It offers hands-on guidance for both newcomers to APIs and those looking to refine their expertise.

Descubra cómo construir eficazmente APIs escalables y RESTful utilizando el lenguaje de programación Go. Este libro le presenta los principios de arquitectura y diseño detrás de los servicios web RESTful y le proporciona el conocimiento práctico para implementar potentes API que satisfacen las demandas del mundo real. Desde el uso del marco Gin para incorporar características avanzadas como autenticación y escalabilidad, obtendrás experiencia práctica.

Lo que este libro me ayudará a hacer

Máster en el diseño e implementación de RESTful APIs utilizando Go.
Aproveche el marco Gin para simplificar el enrutamiento de servicios y el middleware.
Implementar mecanismos de autenticación seguros como OAuth 2.
Construya una biblioteca de clientes para consumir API REST y realizar pruebas de unidad.
Escala tus aplicaciones con microservicios y mejora el rendimiento.

Autor(s)

Ninguno Yellavula es un desarrollador de software experimentado con conocimiento profundo de la construcción de aplicaciones web modernas. Con una pasión por las tecnologías de backend y el diseño de API, Ninguno ha trabajado extensamente con el lenguaje de programación Go en el desarrollo de aplicaciones de alto rendimiento. El enfoque amistoso y práctico adoptado en este libro refleja la dedicación de ninguno para educar a los desarrolladores.

¿Para quién es?

Este libro es ideal para desarrolladores con conocimientos básicos de programación Go que quieren aprender a diseñar e implementar APIs RESTful. Para ingenieros de software, desarrolladores y entusiastas de la tecnología, ayuda a los lectores que buscan crear servicios web escalables. Ofrece orientación práctica para los recién llegados a las API y aquellos que buscan perfeccionar su experiencia.

title: Game Engine Gems 2
description:
This book, the second volume in the popular Game Engine Gems series, contains short articles that focus on a particular technique, describe a clever trick, or offer practical advice within the subject of game engine development. The 31 chapters cover three broad categories—graphics and rendering, game engine design, and systems programming. Professional game developers, students of game development and computer science, and anyone interested in learning how the pros tackle specific problems that arise during game engine development will find useful gems in this collection.

Supplementary materials, including demos, source code, examples, specifications, and more can be found at www.gameenginegems.net.

Los 31 capítulos abarcan tres categorías amplias: gráficos y renderización, diseño de motores de juego y programación de sistemas. Desarrolladores profesionales del juego, estudiantes de desarrollo del juego y ciencias informáticas, y cualquier persona interesada en aprender cómo los pros abordan problemas específicos que surgen durante el desarrollo del motor del juego encontrará gemas útiles en esta colección.

Materiales complementarios, incluyendo demos, código fuente, ejemplos, especificaciones y más se pueden encontrar en www.gameenginegems.net.

title: Build Stunning Real-time VFX with Unreal Engine 5
description:
Learn to create breathtaking visual effects for games and virtual productions using Unreal Engine 5's Niagara particle system. This book provides practical, hands-on steps to mastering the key concepts and workflows needed to craft vivid, real-time VFX that will elevate your projects and amaze your audience.

What this Book will help me do

Understand the architecture of the Niagara particle system in Unreal Engine 5.
Learn to create, debug, and manipulate particle systems effectively.
Design custom modules and use dynamic inputs in Niagara.
Control Niagara systems using Blueprints for more interactive visuals.
Master event handlers and communication between particle emitters.

Author(s)

Hrishikesh Andurlekar is a seasoned VFX artist specializing in real-time visual effects creation for games and virtual productions. With years of expertise in advanced particle systems and Unreal Engine, Hrishikesh brings a wealth of knowledge and practical advice to beginners and seasoned developers alike. His passion for teaching is evident in his structured approach to technical topics, ensuring clarity and engagement throughout.

Who is it for?

This book is ideal for visual effects artists, game programmers, 3D generalists, and game designers who are looking to explore the real-time virtual production workflows of Unreal Engine 5. A basic understanding of Unreal Engine and its core components like Blueprints, materials, and lighting is assumed, making this resource fitting for those keen on advancing their VFX craft efficiently.

title: Let’s Build a Multiplayer Phaser Game: With TypeScript, Socket.IO, and Phaser
description:
Create a fully working multiplayer game from scratch using TypeScript, Socket.IO, and the community edition of Phaser.js. You will achieve amazing feats in the browser without having to install any software. This book teaches you how to use the Phaser game engine APIs to tap into physics, and how to utilize HUD information and fire lasers.

Let’s Build a Multiplayer Phaser Game dives into the details to show you how to create a multiplayer game from beginning to end. Once you have finished this book, you will be well versed in creating not only a game, but also an application that you can extend with new functionality to enjoy with your friends.

What You'll Learn

Discover the ins and outs of Socket.IO for real-time web communication
Use TypeScript to allow your project to be typed and self-documenting
See how gaming mechanics work to make a game entertaining
Get a deeper understanding of how to structure your working directory and your code
Scale what you have created

Who This Book Is For

Developers who want to know how to create and structure a complex online game

Escala lo que has creado

Desarrolladores que quieren saber cómo crear y estructurar un complejo juego en línea

title: The Essential Guide to Creating Multiplayer Games with Godot 4.0
description:
Dive into the world of multiplayer game development with Godot 4.0 using this comprehensive guide. This book walks you through the essentials of setting up online features, optimizing gameplay, and creating engaging multiplayer experiences. Perfect for developers eager to harness the power of Godot's network API.

What this Book will help me do

Master the fundamentals of networking and multiplayer game synchronization.
Build client-server structures with Godot's GDScript network API.
Implement remote procedure calls to enable interactive game features.
Optimize multiplayer games for smooth performance and reduced latency.
Develop and debug real-world projects like online shooters and co-op games.

Author(s)

Henrique Campos is an experienced game developer and technical author with a strong focus on multiplayer systems. With years of hands-on experience using the Godot Engine, Henrique has helped countless developers master its intricacies. He brings a practical and accessible approach to technical challenges, making complex concepts approachable.

title: Head First 2D Geometry
description: Having trouble with geometry? Do Pi, The Pythagorean Theorem, and angle calculations just make your head spin? Relax. Through entertaining stories and practical examples from the world around you, this book takes you beyond boring problems. You'll actually use what you learn to make real-life decisions, like using angles and parallel lines to crack a mysterious CSI case. Put geometry to work for you, and nail your class exams along the way. We think your time is too valuable to waste struggling with new concepts. Using the latest research in cognitive science and learning theory to craft a multi-sensory learning experience, Head First 2D Geometry uses a visually-rich format designed for the way your brain works, not a text-heavy approach that puts you to sleep.

title: Foundation Website Creation with HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript
description:
Foundation Website Creation with HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript shows the entire process of building a website. This process involves much more than just technical knowledge, and this book provides all the information you'll need to understand the concepts behind designing and developing for the Web, as well as the best means to deliver professional results based on best practices.

Of course, there is far more to building a successful website than knowing a little Hypertext Markup Language (HTML). The process starts long before any coding takes place, and this book introduces you to the agile development process, explaining why this method makes so much sense for web projects and how best to implement it. We also make sure you're up to date by using the latest HTML5 features. Planning is vital, so you'll also learn to use techniques such as brainstorming, wireframes, mockups, and prototypes to get your project off to the best possible start and help ensure smooth progress as it develops.

An understanding of correct, semantic markup is essential for any web professional; this book explains how HTML5 should be used to structure content so that the markup adheres to current web standards. You'll learn about the wide range of HTML5 elements available to you, and you'll learn how and when to use them through building example web pages.

Without creative use of Cascading Style Sheets (CSS), websites would all look largely the same. CSS enables you to set your website apart from the rest, while maintaining the integrity of your markup. We'll showcase the new features of CSS3 and how you can use them. You'll learn how CSS3 works and how to apply styles to your pages, allowing you to realize your design ideas in the browser.

JavaScript can be used to make your website easier and more interesting to use. This book provides information on appropriate uses of this technology and introduces the concepts of JavaScript programming. You'll also see how JavaScript works as part of the much-hyped technique Ajax, and in turn, where Ajax fits into the wider Web 2.0 picture.

While a website is being built, it needs to be tested across multiple browsers and platforms to ensure that the site works for all users, regardless of ability or disability, and this book explains how best to accomplish these tasks. Then, it discusses the process of launching and maintaining the site so that it will continue to work for all its users throughout its life cycle.

Foundation Website Creation with HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript concludes by covering server-side technologies, acting as a guide to the different options available. With insights from renowned experts such as Jason Fried of 37signals, Daniel Burka of Digg and Pownce, and Chris Messina of Citizen Agency, Foundation Website Creation with CSS, XHTML, and JavaScript provides invaluable information applicable to every web project—regardless of size, scope, or budget.

What you'll learn

See how the Web has developed and the role of web standards

Learn how to plan and manage the building of a website

Learn how to separate content from presentation with HTML5 and CSS3

See how JavaScript can be used to enhance your website

Learn how best to test, launch, and maintain a website

Who this book is for

Web developers and designers starting out in HTML5 and CSS3.
translatedDescription:
Creación de sitios web con HTML5, CSS3, y JavaScript muestra todo el proceso de construcción de un sitio web. Este proceso implica mucho más que un conocimiento técnico, y este libro proporciona toda la información que necesitará para entender los conceptos detrás de diseñar y desarrollar para la Web, así como los mejores medios para ofrecer resultados profesionales basados en las mejores prácticas.

Por supuesto, hay mucho más para construir un sitio web exitoso que conocer un poco de lenguaje de marcaje hipertexto (HTML). El proceso comienza mucho antes de que cualquier codificación tenga lugar, y este libro le presenta al proceso de desarrollo ágil, explicando por qué este método tiene tanto sentido para los proyectos web y cómo implementarlo mejor. También nos aseguramos de que estés al día usando las últimas funciones HTML5. La planificación es vital, por lo que también aprenderás a usar técnicas tales como el almacenamiento de cerebros, cables, maquetas y prototipos para conseguir tu proyecto al mejor comienzo posible y ayudar a asegurar un progreso suave a medida que se desarrolla.

Una comprensión de la marcación correcta y semántica es esencial para cualquier profesional web; este libro explica cómo HTML5 debe ser utilizado para estructurar el contenido de manera que la marcación se adhiera a los estándares web actuales. Usted aprenderá acerca de la amplia gama de elementos HTML5 disponibles para usted, y usted aprenderá cómo y cuándo utilizarlos a través de páginas web de ejemplo de construcción.

Sin uso creativo de Hojas de Estilo Cascading (CSS), los sitios web se verían en gran parte iguales. CSS le permite establecer su sitio web aparte del resto, manteniendo la integridad de su marcación. Mostraremos las nuevas características de CSS3 y cómo puedes utilizarlas. Aprenderás cómo funciona CSS3 y cómo aplicar estilos a tus páginas, permitiéndote realizar tus ideas de diseño en el navegador.

Puede usar JavaScript para que su sitio web sea más fácil y más interesante de usar. Este libro proporciona información sobre los usos apropiados de esta tecnología e introduce los conceptos de programación JavaScript. También verás cómo JavaScript funciona como parte de la técnica de mucho trabajo Ajax, y a su vez, donde Ajax encaja en la imagen más amplia de Web 2.0.

Si bien se está construyendo un sitio web, es necesario probarlo a través de múltiples navegadores y plataformas para asegurar que el sitio funcione para todos los usuarios, independientemente de su capacidad o discapacidad, y este libro explica lo mejor para realizar estas tareas. Luego, discute el proceso de lanzamiento y mantenimiento del sitio para que continúe trabajando para todos sus usuarios durante todo su ciclo de vida.

Fundación Web Creación con HTML5, CSS3, y JavaScript concluye cubriendo las tecnologías del lado del servidor, actuando como guía de las diferentes opciones disponibles. Con ideas de expertos de renombre como Jason Fried de 37 firmas, Daniel Burka de Digg y Pownce, y Chris Messina de Agencia Ciudadana, Fundación Web Creación con CSS, XHTML y JavaScript proporciona información invaluable aplicable a cada proyecto web, independientemente del tamaño, alcance o presupuesto.

Lo que aprenderás

Vea cómo se ha desarrollado la Web y el papel de las normas web

Aprender a planificar y gestionar la construcción de un sitio web

Aprender a separar el contenido de la presentación con HTML5 y CSS3

Vea cómo se puede utilizar JavaScript para mejorar su sitio web

Aprende lo mejor para probar, lanzar y mantener un sitio web

Para quién es este libro

Desarrolladores y diseñadores web que comienzan en HTML5 y CSS3.

title: Cinematic Game Secrets for Creative Directors and Producers
description:
Cinematography for Games covers the space between the game and film industries by pointing out the most relevant cinematic techniques in today's hottest games, and including interviews with the game industry's greatest luminaries (including Will Wright: Sims legend, Harvey Smith, legendary game Deus Ex, Warren Spector creator of one of the original game companies, Origin).

The convergence of games and film is a widely discussed and debated topic in the game industry. Many major publishers, along with some high-profile directors (John Woo, James Cameron, Steven Spielberg, Tony Scott) are exploring the middle ground between the industries. This book introduces game producers and directors to the tried and true techniques cinematographers have relied on for years.

Game developers learn how to create compelling video games by: developing quality stories and characters; visualizing scenes within the game through the eyes of a cinematographer; using tried and true film industry methods for casting, voice-over, direction, and production.

The book will also feature screen shots from some of today's hottest titles that illustrate key cinematic concepts, as well as advice from successful game industry professionals already using these techniques.

La convergencia de juegos y películas es un tema ampliamente discutido y debatido en la industria del juego. Muchos editores principales, junto con algunos directores de alto perfil (John Woo, James Cameron, Steven Spielberg, Tony Scott) están explorando el terreno medio entre las industrias. Los desarrolladores de juegos aprenden a crear videojuegos convincentes por: desarrollar historias de calidad y personajes; visualizar escenas dentro del juego a través de los ojos de un cinematógrafo; usar métodos probados y verdaderos de la industria cinematográfica para el casting, voz, dirección y producción.

El libro también contará con imágenes de pantalla de algunos de los títulos más calientes de hoy que ilustran conceptos clave cinematográfica, así como consejos de profesionales exitosos de la industria del juego ya utilizando estas técnicas.

title: Finite Element Techniques for Fluid Flow
description: Finite Element Techniques for Fluid Flow describes the advances in the applications of finite element techniques to fluid mechanics. Topics covered range from weighted residual and variational methods to interpolation functions, inviscid fluids, and flow through porous media. The basic principles and governing equations of fluid mechanics as well as problems related to dispersion and shallow water circulation are also discussed. This text is comprised of nine chapters; the first of which explains some basic definitions and properties as well as the basic principles of weighted residual and variational methods. The reader is then introduced to the simple finite element concepts and models, and gradually to more complex applications. The chapters that follow focus on the governing equations of fluid flow, the solutions to potential type problems, and viscous flow problems in porous media. The solutions to more specialized problems are also presented. This book also considers how circulation problems can be tackled using finite elements, presents a solution to the mass transfer equation, and concludes with an explanation of how to solve general transient incompressible flows. This source will be of use to engineers, applied mathematicians, physicists, self-taught students, and research workers.
translatedDescription: Técnicas de Elemento Finito para Fluid Flow describe los avances en las aplicaciones de técnicas de elementos finitos a la mecánica de fluidos. Los temas tratados van desde métodos residuales ponderados y de variación hasta funciones de interpolación, fluidos invisivos y flujo a través de medios porosos. También se examinan los principios básicos y las ecuaciones que rigen la mecánica de fluidos, así como los problemas relacionados con la dispersión y la circulación de agua poco profunda. Este texto está compuesto por nueve capítulos; el primero de los cuales explica algunas definiciones y propiedades básicas, así como los principios básicos de los métodos residuales y de variación ponderados. El lector se introduce luego en los simples conceptos y modelos de elementos finitos, y gradualmente a aplicaciones más complejas. Los capítulos que siguen se centran en las ecuaciones que rigen el flujo de fluidos, las soluciones a posibles problemas de tipo y los problemas de flujo viscosos en los medios porosos. También se presentan soluciones a problemas más especializados. Este libro también considera cómo se pueden abordar los problemas de circulación utilizando elementos finitos, presenta una solución a la ecuación de transferencia masiva, y concluye con una explicación de cómo resolver flujos incompresibles transitorios generales. Esta fuente será de uso para ingenieros, matemáticos aplicados, físicos, estudiantes autodidactas y trabajadores de investigación.

title: Pro HTML5 and CSS3 Design Patterns
description:
Pro HTML5 and CSS3 Design Patterns is a reference book and a cookbook on how to style web pages using CSS3 and HTML5. It contains 350 ready–to–use patterns (CSS3 and HTML5 code snippets) that you can copy and paste into your code. Each pattern can be combined with other patterns to create an unlimited number of solutions, and each pattern works reliably in all major browsers without the need for browser hacks.

The book is completely up-to-date with code, best practices, and browser compatibilities for HTML5 and CSS3—enabling you to dive in and make use of these new technologies in production environments.

Pro HTML5 and CSS3 Design Patterns is so much more than just a cookbook, though! It systematically covers every usable feature of CSS3 and combines these features with HTML5 to create reusable patterns. Each pattern has an intuitive name to make it easy to find, remember, and refer to. Accessibility and best practices are carefully engineered into each design pattern, example, and source code.

The book's layout, with a pattern's example on the left page and its explanation on the right, makes it easy to find a pattern and study it without having to flip between pages. The book is also readable from cover to cover, with topics building carefully upon previous topics.

Pro HTML5 and CSS3 Design Patterns book unleashes your productivity and creativity in web design and development. Instead of hacking your way toward a solution, you'll learn how to predictably create successful designs every time by reusing and combining modular design patterns.
