Explore un método alternativo de desarrollo de aplicaciones de vanguardia sin usar marcos o bibliotecas de terceros. Este libro le proporciona las habilidades y la libertad necesarias para considerar un enfoque “no marco” al elegir una tecnología para crear un nuevo proyecto.

Trabajarás a través de los temas más importantes de una manera clara y sensata, utilizando métodos prácticos y herramientas para comprender los requisitos no funcionales. Este libro responde a preguntas sobre temas importantes como la gestión del estado, la creación de un sistema de enrutamiento, la creación de un cliente REST utilizando embrague, y revela los intercambios y riesgos asociados con la elección del marco o herramienta incorrectos para su proyecto, así como proporcionar alternativas sostenibles y funcionales.

Frameworkless Front-End Development rompe el concepto de deuda técnica y las formas en que un marco puede afectar la vida útil de un proyecto. Además de obtener una guía completa y clara sobre codificación de manera efectiva desde cero sin marcos, también aprenderá algunos principios de toma de decisiones técnicas.

Lo que aprenderás:

Revise cómo funciona la manipulación DOM
Administrar el estado de una aplicación frontal con diferentes patrones
Migración segura de las aplicaciones existentes a un nuevo marco o código sin marco
Use herramientas de toma de decisiones como un cuadro de compatibilidad marco y un choque arquitectónico
Vea cómo la elección de los marcos puede afectar la ‘salud’ y la vida útil de una base de código

¿Quién es este libro para:

Desarrolladores JavaScript; gestores técnicos responsables de ayudar a los equipos a elegir pilas tecnológicas para nuevos proyectos; consultores que pretenden refactorizar códigos delanteros JavaScript existentes

title: Developing 2D Games with Unity: Independent Game Programming with C#
description:
Follow a walkthrough of the Unity Engine and learn important 2D-centric lessons in scripting, working with image assets, animations, cameras, collision detection, and state management. In addition to the fundamentals, you'll learn best practices, helpful game-architectural patterns, and how to customize Unity to suit your needs, all in the context of building a working 2D game.

While many books focus on 3D game creation with Unity, the easiest market for an independent developer to thrive in is 2D games. 2D games are generally cheaper to produce, more feasible for small teams, and more likely to be completed. If you live and breathe games and want to create them then 2D games are a great place to start. 

By focusing exclusively on 2D games and Unity’s ever-expanding 2D workflow, this book gives aspiring independent game developers the tools they need to thrive. Various real-world examples of independent games are used to teach fundamental concepts of developing2D games in Unity, using the very latest tools in Unity’s updated 2D workflow. 

New all-digital channels for distribution, such as Nintendo eShop, XBox Live Marketplace, the Playstation Store, the App Store, Google Play, itch.io, Steam, and GOG.com have made it easier than ever to discover, buy, and sell games. The golden age of independent gaming is upon us, and there has never been a better time to get creative, roll up your sleeves, and build that game you’ve always dreamed about. Developing 2D Games with Unity can show you the way.

What You'll Learn

Delve deeply into useful 2D topics, such as sprites, tile slicing, and the brand new Tilemap feature.
Build a working 2D RPG-style game as you learn.
Construct a flexible and extensible game architecture using Unity-specific tools like Scriptable Objects, Cinemachine, and Prefabs.
Take advantage of the streamlined 2D workflow provided by the Unity environment.
 Deploy games to desktop

Who This Book Is For

Hobbyists with some knowledge of programming, as well as seasoned programmers interested in learning to make games independent of a major studio.

Además de los fundamentos, usted aprenderá las mejores prácticas, patrones útiles de juego-arquitectura, y cómo personalizar la unidad para adaptarse a sus necesidades, todo en el contexto de la construcción de un juego 2D de trabajo.

Mientras que muchos libros se centran en la creación de juegos 3D con Unity, el mercado más fácil para un desarrollador independiente para prosperar es juegos 2D. Los juegos 2D son generalmente más baratos para producir, más factible para los equipos pequeños, y más probable que se complete. Si usted vive y respira juegos y quiere crearlos entonces los juegos 2D son un gran lugar para empezar.

Centrándose exclusivamente en juegos 2D y el flujo de trabajo 2D de Unity, este libro ofrece a los aspirantes a desarrolladores independientes de juegos las herramientas que necesitan para prosperar. Varios ejemplos reales de juegos independientes se utilizan para enseñar conceptos fundamentales de desarrollo de juegos2D en Unity, utilizando las últimas herramientas en el flujo de trabajo 2D actualizado de Unity.

Nuevos canales todo digital para distribución, como Nintendo eShop, XBox Live Marketplace, la Playstation Store, Google Play, itch.io, Steam y GOG.com han hecho más fácil que nunca descubrir, comprar y vender juegos. La edad dorada de juego independiente está sobre nosotros, y nunca ha habido un mejor momento para ser creativo, enrollar sus mangas, y construir ese juego que siempre ha soñado con. Desarrollar juegos 2D con Unity puede mostrarte el camino.

Lo que aprenderás

Deslizar profundamente en temas útiles de 2D, como sprites, corte de azulejos y la nueva característica de Tilemap.
Construye un juego de estilo 2D RPG mientras aprendes.
Construir una arquitectura de juego flexible y extensible usando herramientas específicas de Unity como objetos Scriptables, Cinemachine y Prefabs.
Aproveche el flujo de trabajo 2D simplificado proporcionado por el entorno Unity.
Despliegue juegos a escritorio

Quién es este libro

Hobbyists con algunos conocimientos de programación, así como programadores experimentados interesados en aprender a hacer juegos independientes de un estudio importante.

title: Deep Reinforcement Learning in Unity: With Unity ML Toolkit
description:
Gain an in-depth overview of reinforcement learning for autonomous agents in game development with Unity.

This book starts with an introduction to state-based reinforcement learning algorithms involving Markov models, Bellman equations, and writing custom C# code with the aim of contrasting value and policy-based functions in reinforcement learning. Then, you will move on to path finding and navigation meshes in Unity, setting up the ML Agents Toolkit (including how to install and set up ML agents from the GitHub repository), and installing fundamental machine learning libraries and frameworks (such as Tensorflow). You will learn about: deep learning and work through an introduction to Tensorflow for writing neural networks (including perceptron, convolution, and LSTM networks), Q learning with Unity ML agents, and porting trained neural network models in Unity through the Python-C# API. You will also explore the OpenAI Gym Environment used throughout the book.

Deep Reinforcement Learning in Unity provides a walk-through of the core fundamentals of deep reinforcement learning algorithms, especially variants of the value estimation, advantage, and policy gradient algorithms (including the differences between on and off policy algorithms in reinforcement learning). These core algorithms include actor critic, proximal policy, and deep deterministic policy gradients and its variants. And you will be able to write custom neural networks using the Tensorflow and Keras frameworks.

Deep learning in games makes the agents learn how they can perform better and collect their rewards in adverse environments without user interference. The book provides a thorough overview of integrating ML Agents with Unity for deep reinforcement learning.

What You Will Learn

Understand how deep reinforcement learning works in games
Grasp the fundamentals of deep reinforcement learning 
Integrate these fundamentals with the Unity ML Toolkit SDK
Gain insights into practical neural networks for training Agent Brain in the context of Unity ML Agents
Create different models and perform hyper-parameter tuning
Understand the Brain-Academy architecture in Unity ML Agents
Understand the Python-C# API interface during real-time training of neural networks
Grasp the fundamentals of generic neural networks and their variants using Tensorflow
Create simulations and visualize agents playing games in Unity

Who This Book Is For

Readers with preliminary programming and game development experience in Unity, and those with experience in Python and a general idea of machine learning
translatedDescription:
Obtenga una visión detallada del aprendizaje de refuerzo para agentes autónomos en el desarrollo de juegos con Unity.

Este libro comienza con una introducción a algoritmos estatales de aprendizaje de refuerzo que involucran modelos Markov, ecuaciones Bellman, y escribiendo código C# personalizado con el objetivo de contrastar el valor y las funciones políticas en el aprendizaje de refuerzo. A continuación, se desplazará hacia la búsqueda y navegación de mallas en Unity, estableciendo el kit de herramientas ML Agents (incluyendo cómo instalar y configurar agentes ML del repositorio GitHub), e instalando bibliotecas y marcos fundamentales de aprendizaje automático (como Tensorflow). Usted aprenderá sobre: aprendizaje profundo y trabajar a través de una introducción a Tensorflow para escribir redes neuronales (incluyendo las redes de perceptron, convolution y LSTM), Q learning con agentes de Unity ML, y portar modelos de red neuronales capacitados en Unity a través de la API Python-C#. También explorará el entorno Gimnasio OpenAI utilizado a lo largo del libro.

Aprendizaje de Reforzamiento Profundo en Unidad proporciona un paso a través de los fundamentos básicos de algoritmos de aprendizaje de refuerzo profundo, especialmente variantes de la estimación de valor, ventaja y algoritmos de gradiente de políticas (incluyendo las diferencias entre algoritmos de política en y fuera en el aprendizaje de refuerzo). Estos algoritmos básicos incluyen el crítico actor, la política proximal y los gradientes de políticas deterministas profundos y sus variantes. Y podrás escribir redes neuronales personalizadas usando los marcos Tensorflow y Keras.

El aprendizaje profundo en juegos hace que los agentes aprendan cómo pueden realizar mejor y recoger sus recompensas en entornos adversos sin interferencia del usuario. El libro ofrece una visión completa de la integración de los agentes ML con Unity para el aprendizaje profundo del refuerzo.

Qué aprenderás

Entender cómo el aprendizaje de refuerzo profundo funciona en juegos
Grasp the fundamentals of deep reinforcement learning
Integrar estos fundamentos con el SDK Unity ML Toolkit
Obtenga información sobre redes neuronales prácticas para entrenar al agente Brain en el contexto de los agentes de Unity ML
Crear diferentes modelos y realizar afinación hiperparamétrica
Entender la arquitectura Brain-Academy en Unity ML Agents
Comprender la interfaz API Python-C# durante el entrenamiento en tiempo real de redes neuronales
Grasp los fundamentos de las redes neuronales genéricas y sus variantes usando Tensorflow
Crear simulaciones y visualizar agentes jugando juegos en Unity

Quién es este libro

Los lectores con experiencia de programación preliminar y desarrollo de juegos en Unity, y aquellos con experiencia en Python y una idea general de aprendizaje automático

title: Evolutionary Computation in Gene Regulatory Network Research
description:
Introducing a handbook for gene regulatory network research using evolutionary computation, with applications for computer scientists, computational and system biologists

This book is a step-by-step guideline for research in gene regulatory networks (GRN) using evolutionary computation (EC). The book is organized into four parts that deliver materials in a way equally attractive for a reader with training in computation or biology. Each of these sections, authored by well-known researchers and experienced practitioners, provides the relevant materials for the interested readers. The first part of this book contains an introductory background to the field. The second part presents the EC approaches for analysis and reconstruction of GRN from gene expression data. The third part of this book covers the contemporary advancements in the automatic construction of gene regulatory and reaction networks and gives direction and guidelines for future research. Finally, the last part of this book focuses on applications of GRNs with EC in other fields, such as design, engineering and robotics.

• Provides a reference for current and future research in gene regulatory networks (GRN) using evolutionary computation (EC)

• Covers sub-domains of GRN research using EC, such as expression profile analysis, reverse engineering, GRN evolution, applications

• Contains useful contents for courses in gene regulatory networks, systems biology, computational biology, and synthetic biology

• Delivers state-of-the-art research in genetic algorithms, genetic programming, and swarm intelligence

Evolutionary Computation in Gene Regulatory Network Research is a reference for researchers and professionals in computer science, systems biology, and bioinformatics, as well as upper undergraduate, graduate, and postgraduate students.

Hitoshi Iba is a Professor in the Department of Information and Communication Engineering, Graduate School of Information Science and Technology, at the University of Tokyo, Toyko, Japan. He is an Associate Editor of the IEEE Transactions on Evolutionary Computation and the journal of Genetic Programming and Evolvable Machines. Nasimul Noman is a lecturer in the School of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science at the University of Newcastle, NSW, Australia. From 2002 to 2012 he was a faculty member at the University of Dhaka, Bangladesh. Noman is an Editor of the BioMed Research International journal. His research interests include computational biology, synthetic biology, and bioinformatics.

El libro se organiza en cuatro partes que entregan materiales de manera igualmente atractiva para un lector con formación en computación o biología. La primera parte de este libro contiene un fondo introductorio al campo. La segunda parte presenta los enfoques de la CE para el análisis y la reconstrucción del GRN de datos de expresión genética. La tercera parte de este libro cubre los avances contemporáneos en la construcción automática de redes de regulación y reacción de genes y da dirección y directrices para futuras investigaciones. Finalmente, la última parte de este libro se centra en aplicaciones de GRNs con EC en otros campos, como diseño, ingeniería y robótica.

• Cubre subdominios de investigación GRN utilizando EC, como análisis de perfiles de expresión, ingeniería inversa, evolución GRN, aplicaciones

• Contiene contenidos útiles para cursos en redes reguladoras genéticas, biología de sistemas, biología computacional y biología sintética

• Ofrece investigación de vanguardia en algoritmos genéticos, programación genética e inteligencia enjambre

Computación Evolutiva en Investigación de Red Reguladora de Genes es una referencia para investigadores y profesionales en ciencias informáticas, biología de sistemas y bioinformática, así como estudiantes de grado superior, graduado y posgrado.

Hitoshi Iba es profesor en el Departamento de Ingeniería de la Información y las Comunicaciones, Facultad de Ciencias y Tecnología de la Información de la Universidad de Tokio, Toyko, Japón. Es editor asociado de las transacciones de IEEE sobre la computación evolutiva y la revista de programación genética y máquinas evolucionables. De 2002 a 2012 fue profesor en la Universidad de Dhaka, Bangladesh. Noman es editor de la revista BioMed Research International. Sus intereses de investigación incluyen biología computacional, biología sintética y bioinformática.

title: Go Cookbook
description:
Unlock the full potential of Go (Golang) with the 'Go Cookbook', a comprehensive resource for enhancing your programming skills. Dive into advanced topics like error handling, concurrency, and serverless programming, and gain practical insights with real-world recipes. This book is a complete guide to building efficient, modular, and testable Go applications.

What this Book will help me do

Understand advanced testing methodologies to ensure the reliability of your applications.
Master error handling techniques for cleaner and more robust Go programs.
Learn to implement concurrency and distributed systems like web servers and APIs.
Acquire practical experience with serverless programming and microservices in Go.
Build a strong foundation in Go application design, including working with databases and I/O.

None Torres is a seasoned software developer with expertise in Go (Golang). They bring years of experience designing and building back-end systems, and their teaching approach emphasizes hands-on practices with attention to detail. This book is perfect for developers currently familiar with the basics of Go who want to deepen their knowledge. Whether you're a professional back-end developer or a tech enthusiast looking to explore advanced Go programming techniques, this book will serve as a valuable resource. Readers are encouraged to have basic programming knowledge to make the most of the recipes and concepts covered. It's an excellent choice for those aspiring to apply Go in practical, production-like scenarios.

title: Inflection Points
description:
Discover your purpose with the Game Plan System

In Inflection Points: How to Work and Live with Purpose, renowned executive coach and speaker Matt Spielman delivers an energizing and hands-on existential navigational tool that walks you through how to identify what really matters in life and how to achieve it. Using a powerful life transformation system called the “Game Plan System”—or GPS —you will simply use the answers to straightforward questions to reorient your perspective and refocus your efforts on realizing happiness and fulfilment.

In the book, you will also learn to:

Create a powerful new roadmap to achieve what truly matters to you and move aside what may be getting in the way
Celebrate your wins and effectively process your setbacks
Discover and consider the value of coaching in your personal and professional life

The perfect book for anyone hoping to move through life with confident and renewed purpose and vigor, Inflection Points is an expertly crafted and powerful collection of strategies to act with more intentionality, help yourself and others, and realize your goals and achieve greater fulfillment.
translatedDescription:
Descubra su propósito con el sistema de planes de juego

En Puntos de Inflexión: Cómo trabajar y vivir con el propósito, el renombrado entrenador ejecutivo y el altavoz Matt Spielman ofrece una herramienta de navegación existencial energizante y práctica que te lleva a través de cómo identificar lo que realmente importa en la vida y cómo lograrlo. Usando un poderoso sistema de transformación de la vida llamado “sistema de planes de juegos” o GPS, simplemente usarás las respuestas a preguntas directas para reorientar tu perspectiva y reorientar tus esfuerzos en la realización de la felicidad y el cumplimiento.

Crear una nueva hoja de ruta poderosa para lograr lo que realmente le importa y dejar de lado lo que puede ser conseguir en el camino
Celebra tus victorias y procesa eficazmente tus contratiempos
Descubre y considera el valor del entrenamiento en tu vida personal y profesional

El libro perfecto para cualquier persona que desee pasar por la vida con propósito y vigor confiados y renovados, Inflection Points es una colección experta y poderosa de estrategias para actuar con más intencionalidad, ayudarse a sí mismo y a otros, y realizar sus metas y lograr mayor cumplimiento.

title: Out of Water: From Abundance to Scarcity and How to Solve the World’s Water Problems
description: From cities to biofuels, competition for water is accelerating. Climate change threatens to intensify the onset and severity of the water crisis in several regions of the developing world: this is already happening throughout much of Asia, the Mediterranean, southwestern Australia, and the southwestern US. Along with water shortages, unsafe water becomes an increasingly widespread problem, too. As water crises trigger food and health crises, billions may slip further into poverty, leading to greater social and political unrest, new wars, and worsening national security. Out of Water doesn't just illuminate the coming global water crisis: it presents innovative solutions in agriculture, engineering, governance, and beyond, including state-of-the art techniques for integrated water management. This book will help raise the level of debate about water to the highest levels of government, and identify workable reforms and incentives to help water users utilize this crucial resource far more efficiently.
translatedDescription: De ciudades a biocombustibles, la competencia por el agua se está acelerando. El cambio climático amenaza con intensificar el comienzo y la gravedad de la crisis hídrica en varias regiones del mundo en desarrollo: esto ya está ocurriendo en gran parte de Asia, el Mediterráneo, el sudoeste de Australia y el sudoeste de Estados Unidos. Junto con la escasez de agua, el agua insegura también se convierte en un problema cada vez más generalizado. A medida que las crisis del agua desencadenan crisis alimentarias y sanitarias, miles de millones de personas pueden caer más en la pobreza, lo que lleva a un mayor malestar social y político, nuevas guerras y empeoramiento de la seguridad nacional. Fuera del agua no solo ilumina la crisis mundial del agua: presenta soluciones innovadoras en agricultura, ingeniería, gobernanza y más allá, incluyendo técnicas de última generación para la gestión integrada del agua. Este libro ayudará a elevar el nivel de debate sobre el agua a los más altos niveles de gobierno, e identificar reformas y incentivos viables para ayudar a los usuarios del agua a utilizar este recurso crucial de manera más eficiente.

title: Building Hypermedia APIs with HTML5 and Node
description:
With this concise book, you’ll learn the art of building hypermedia APIs that don’t simply run on the Web, but that actually exist in the Web. You’ll start with the general principles and technologies behind this architectural approach, and then dive hands-on into three fully-functional API examples.

Too many APIs rely on concepts rooted in desktop and local area network patterns that don’t scale well—costly solutions that are difficult to maintain over time. This book shows system architects and web developers how to design and implement human- and machine-readable web services that remain stable and flexible as they scale.

Learn the H-Factors for representing application metadata across all media types and formats
Understand the four basic design elements for authoring hypermedia types
Convert a simple read-only XML-based media type into a successful API design
Examine the challenges and advantages of designing a hypermedia type with JSON
Use HTML5’s rich set of hypermedia controls in the API design process
Learn the details of documenting, publishing, and registering media type designs and link-relation types

Usted comenzará con los principios generales y las tecnologías detrás de este enfoque arquitectónico, y luego buceará mano a mano en tres ejemplos API totalmente funcionales.

Demasiados API confían en conceptos arraigados en patrones de red de escritorio y área local que no escalan soluciones costosas que son difíciles de mantener con el tiempo. Este libro muestra a arquitectos de sistemas y desarrolladores web cómo diseñar e implementar servicios web legibles para humanos y máquinas que permanecen estables y flexibles a medida que escalan.

Aprende los H-Factors para representar metadatos de aplicaciones en todos los tipos y formatos multimedia

Examine los retos y ventajas de diseñar un tipo hipermedia con JSON
Utilice el rico conjunto de controles de hipermedia de HTML5 en el proceso de diseño de API

title: Programming HTML5 Applications
description:
HTML5 is not just a replacement for plugins. It also makes the Web a first-class development environment by giving JavaScript programmers a solid foundation for building industrial-strength applications. This practical guide takes you beyond simple site creation and shows you how to build self-contained HTML5 applications that can run on mobile devices and compete with desktop apps.

You’ll learn powerful JavaScript tools for exploiting HTML5 elements, and discover new methods for working with data, such as offline storage and multithreaded processing. Complete with code samples, this book is ideal for experienced JavaScript and mobile developers alike.

Store session data in the browser with local storage objects
Save trips to the server: store larger amounts of data with IndexedDB
Give browsers limited access to a user’s system to read and upload files
Take your app offline—and speed up page loading when it’s online
Use Web Workers to create multithreaded applications
Transfer data between browser and server more efficiently with Web Sockets
Learn about HTML5 tags for forms, multimedia, graphics, and geolocation

"HTML5 is all the rage these days, but it's more than just a buzzword. Programming HTML5 Applications provides the knowledge to guide you through all the new technologies needed to make modern web applications."--Ralph Whitbeck, cohost of The Official jQuery Podcast

HTML5 no es sólo un reemplazo para plugins. También hace de la Web un entorno de desarrollo de primera clase dando a los programadores JavaScript una base sólida para la construcción de aplicaciones de fuerza industrial. Esta guía práctica le lleva más allá de la simple creación del sitio y le muestra cómo construir aplicaciones HTML5 autocontenidas que pueden funcionar en dispositivos móviles y competir con aplicaciones de escritorio.

Aprenderás potentes herramientas JavaScript para explotar elementos HTML5 y descubrirás nuevos métodos para trabajar con datos, como almacenamiento sin conexión y procesamiento multitele. Completa con muestras de código, este libro es ideal para desarrolladores de JavaScript experimentados y móviles por igual.

Almacene datos de sesión en el navegador con objetos de almacenamiento local
Guardar viajes al servidor: almacenar grandes cantidades de datos con IndexedDB
Dar acceso limitado a los navegadores al sistema del usuario para leer y subir archivos
Tome su aplicación fuera de línea - y acelerar la carga de página cuando está en línea
Utilice Web Workers para crear aplicaciones multiteleadas
Transfiera datos entre el navegador y el servidor de manera más eficiente con Web Sockets
Aprende sobre etiquetas HTML5 para formas, multimedia, gráficos y geolocalización

"HTML5 es toda la rabia en estos días, pero es más que una palabra de zumbido. Programación HTML5 Applications proporciona el conocimiento para guiarle a través de todas las nuevas tecnologías necesarias para hacer aplicaciones web modernas."--Ralph Whitbeck, cohost of The Official jQuery Podcast

title: Basic Math for Game Development with Unity 3D: A Beginner's Guide to Mathematical Foundations
description:
Use Unity-based examples to understand fundamental mathematical concepts and see how they are applied when building modern video game functionality. You will gain the theoretical foundation you need, and you will know how to examine and modify an implementation.

This book covers points in a 3D Cartesian coordinate system, and then discusses vectors and the details of dot and cross products. Basic mathematical foundations are illustrated through Unity-based example implementations. Also provided are examples showing how the concepts are applied when implementing video game functionality, such as collision support, motion simulations, autonomous behaviors, shadow approximations, and reflection off arbitrary walls.

Throughout this book, you learn and examine the concepts and their applications in a game engine.

What You Will Learn

Understand the basic concepts of points and vectors and their applications in game development
Apply mathematical concepts to modern video game functionality, such as spherical and box colliders
Implement autonomous behaviors, including following way points, facing a target, chasing an object, etc.

Who This Book is For

Beginners, and those interested in the implementation of interactive games, who need a basic mathematical background or a refresher with modern examples
translatedDescription:
Utilice ejemplos basados en Unity para entender conceptos matemáticos fundamentales y ver cómo se aplican al construir la funcionalidad moderna del videojuego. Ganarás la base teórica que necesitas, y sabrás cómo examinar y modificar una implementación.

Este libro cubre puntos en un sistema de coordenadas cartesiano 3D, y luego discute vectores y los detalles de puntos y productos cruzados. Las bases matemáticas básicas se ilustran a través de implementaciones de ejemplo basadas en la unidad. También se proporcionan ejemplos que muestran cómo se aplican los conceptos al implementar la funcionalidad de videojuegos, como soporte de colisión, simulaciones de movimiento, comportamientos autónomos, aproximaciones de sombras y reflejo de paredes arbitrarias.

A lo largo de este libro, usted aprende y examina los conceptos y sus aplicaciones en un motor de juego.

Qué aprenderás

Entender los conceptos básicos de puntos y vectores y sus aplicaciones en el desarrollo del juego
Aplicar conceptos matemáticos a la funcionalidad moderna del videojuego, como colisionadores esféricos y de caja
Implementar comportamientos autónomos, incluyendo puntos de seguimiento, frente a un objetivo, persiguiendo un objeto, etc.

Quién es este libro

Los principiantes, y los interesados en la implementación de juegos interactivos, que necesitan un fondo matemático básico o un refresco con ejemplos modernos

title: Dynamic Story Scripting with the ink Scripting Language
description:
"Dynamic Story Scripting with the ink Scripting Language" introduces readers to ink, a powerful scripting language designed for creating interactive storytelling experiences in Unity. In this book, you will master its syntax and functionality to craft branching narratives, dialogue systems, and procedural storytelling patterns integrated into Unity projects.

What this Book will help me do

Understand the core structure of ink scripts and how stories are represented as code.
Learn to integrate ink-written stories into Unity projects for interactive experiences.
Build dynamic features such as dialogue systems and quest management using the ink and Unity APIs.
Utilize variables and functions within ink for creating adaptive and complex story flows.
Discover techniques for defining and implementing procedural narratives directly into Unity projects.

Author(s)

Daniel Cox is a seasoned developer with extensive experience in narrative-driven game design. Having worked on numerous Unity projects, he combines technical expertise with a deep understanding of storytelling mechanics. His approachable writing makes complex topics accessible, ideal for learners looking to elevate their interactive storytelling skills.

Who is it for?

If you're a Unity developer eager to incorporate compelling narratives into your projects or an author exploring the opportunities of interactive storytelling, this book is designed for you. It's well-suited for those with basic Unity and game development knowledge. Whether you're seeking to enhance your skills or start building narrative-driven games, this book provides practical guidance and valuable insights.

title: LibGDX Game Development By Example
description:
Dive into game development with 'LibGDX Game Development By Example', a comprehensive guide to crafting engaging games using the LibGDX framework. This book walks you through the process by building practical projects, such as a basic Snake game and an Angry Birds-style game, from start to finish. You'll master game design concepts, cross-platform deployment, and essential features.

What this Book will help me do

Learn to set up and utilize the LibGDX framework for 2D game development.
Understand cross-platform game deployment for Windows, Android, HTML5, and more.
Design and implement robust game structures including menus, animations, and interactions.
Utilize LibGDX's 2D tile map API to build dynamic and interactive worlds.
Create physics-based gameplay by leveraging the Box2D physics engine integration.

Author(s)

James Cook is a seasoned game developer and an expert in Java-based tools, having worked on numerous projects with the LibGDX framework. With a passion for teaching, James explains technical concepts through clear examples and practical demonstration. This book reflects his commitment to making game development accessible and rewarding for learners.

Who is it for?

This book is aimed at aspiring game developers who want to learn using the LibGDX framework. While some basic programming experience, preferably in Java, is beneficial, the content is approachable for motivated beginners. Readers who want to start creating platform-independent games will find this guide perfect. If you aim to expand your coding skills and create your own games, this book is for you.

Comprenda el despliegue de juego multiplataforma para Windows, Android, HTML5, y más.

title: Learn C++ for Game Development
description:
"

If you're new to C++ but understand some basic programming, then Learn C++ for Game Development lays the foundation for the C++ language and API that you'll need to build game apps and applications.

Learn C++ for Game Development will show you how to:

Master C++ features such as variables, pointers, flow controls, functions, I/O, classes, exceptions, templates, and the Standard Template Library (STL)
Use design patterns to simplify your coding and make more powerful games
Manage memory efficiently to get the most out of your creativity
Load and save games using file I/O, so that your users are never disappointed

Most of today's popular console and PC game platforms use C++ in their SDKs. Even the Android NDK and now the iOS SDK allow for C++; so C++ is growing in use for today's mobile game apps. Game apps using C++ become much more robust, better looking, more dynamic, and better performing. After reading this book, you'll have the skills to become a successful and profitable game app or applications developer in today's increasingly competitive indie game marketplace.

The next stage is to take the foundation from this book and explore SDKs such as Android/Ouya, PlayStation, Wii, Nintendo DS, DirectX, Unity3D, and GameMaker Studio to make your career really take off.

"

It walks you through the process of designing for the puzzle and casual game genres and shows you how to use the right techniques to create fun and challenging experiences for your players.

title: Introduction to Video Game Engine Development: Learn to Design, Implement, and Use a Cross-Platform 2D Game Engine
description:
Start your video game development journey by learning how to build a 2D game engine from scratch. Using Java (with NetBeans as your IDE and using Java’s graphics framework) or by following along in C# (with Visual Studio as your IDE and using the MonoGame framework), you’ll cover the design and implementation of a 2D game engine in detail. Each class will be reviewed with demonstration code. You’ll gain experience using the engine by building a game from the ground up.

Introduction to Video Game Engine Development reviews the design and implementation of a 2D game engine in three parts. Part 1 covers the low-level API class by class. You’ll see how to abstract lower-level functionality and design a set of classes that interact seamlessly with each other. You’ll learn how to draw objects, play sounds, render text, and more. In Part 2, you’ll review the mid-level API that is responsible for drawing the game, loading resources, and managing user input. Lastly, in Part 3, you’ll build a game from the ground up following a step-by-step process using the 2D game engine you just reviewed.

On completing this book, you’ll have a solid foundation in video game engine design and implementation. You’ll also get exposure to building games from scratch, creating the solid foundation you’ll need to work with more advanced game engines, and industry tools, that require learning complex software, APIs, and IDEs.  

What You Will Learn

Gain experience with lower-level game engine APIs and abstracting framework functionality
Write application-level APIs: launching the game, loading resources, settings, processing input, and more
Discover cross-platform APIs in the game engine projects written in both Java and C#/MonoGame
Develop games with an SDK-based game engine and simplified tool chain focused on direct control of the game through code
Master creating games by using the game engine to build a game from the ground up with only code and an IDE

Who This Book Is For 

Those of you out there with some programming experience, moderate to advanced, who want to learn how to write video games using modern game engine designs.
translatedDescription:
Comience su viaje de desarrollo de videojuegos aprendiendo cómo construir un motor de juego 2D desde cero. Usando Java (con NetBeans como su IDE y utilizando el marco gráfico de Java) o siguiendo a lo largo de C# (con Visual Studio como su IDE y utilizando el marco MonoGame), cubrirás el diseño e implementación de un motor de juego 2D en detalle. Cada clase será revisada con código de demostración. Ganarás experiencia usando el motor construyendo un juego desde el suelo.

Introducción a Video Game Engine Development revisa el diseño e implementación de un motor de juego 2D en tres partes. La parte 1 cubre la clase API de bajo nivel por clase. Verás cómo abstraer la funcionalidad de nivel inferior y diseñar un conjunto de clases que interactúan perfectamente entre sí. Aprenderás a dibujar objetos, tocar sonidos, renderizar texto y más. En la Parte 2, revisarás la API de nivel medio que es responsable de dibujar el juego, cargar recursos y gestionar la entrada del usuario. Por último, en la Parte 3, construirás un juego desde el suelo siguiendo un proceso paso a paso utilizando el motor de juego 2D que acabas de revisar.

Al completar este libro, usted tendrá una base sólida en el diseño e implementación del motor de videojuegos. También obtendrá la exposición a los juegos de construcción desde cero, creando la base sólida que necesitará trabajar con motores de juego más avanzados, y herramientas de la industria, que requieren el aprendizaje de software complejo, APIs e IDEs.

Qué aprenderás

Obtenga experiencia con APIs de motor de juego de menor nivel y funcionalidad de marco abstracto
Escribe APIs de nivel de aplicación: lanzamiento del juego, recursos de carga, ajustes, entrada de procesamiento y más
Descubre API multiplataforma en los proyectos de motores de juego escritos tanto en Java como en C#/MonoGame
Desarrollar juegos con un motor de juego basado en SDK y una cadena de herramientas simplificada centrada en el control directo del juego a través del código
Master creando juegos utilizando el motor del juego para construir un juego desde el suelo con sólo código y un IDE

Quién es este libro

Aquellos de ustedes ahí fuera con alguna experiencia de programación, moderada a avanzada, que quieren aprender a escribir videojuegos usando diseños modernos de motores de juego.

title: Information Storage and Management: Storing, Managing, and Protecting Digital Information
description:
The spiraling growth of digital information makes the ISM book a "must have" addition to your IT reference library. This exponential growth has driven information management technology to new levels of sophistication and complexity, exposing a skills gap that challenge IT managers and professionals alike. The ISM book, written by storage professionals from EMC Corporation, takes an ‘open’ approach to teaching information storage and management, focusing on concepts and principles – rather that product specifics – that can be applied in all IT environments

The book enables existing and aspiring IT professionals, students, faculty, and those simply wishing to gain deeper insight to this emerging pillar of IT infrastructure to achieve a comprehensive understanding of all segments of information storage technology.

Sixteen chapters are organized into four sections. Advanced topics build upon the topics learned in previous chapters.

Section 1, "Information Storage and Management for Today’s World": Four chapters cover information growth and challenges, define a storage system and its environment, review the evolution of storage technology, and introduce intelligent storage systems.

Section 2, "Storage Options and Protocols": Six chapters cover the SCSI and Fibre channel architecture, direct-attached storage (DAS), storage area networks (SANs), network-attached storage (NAS), Internet Protocol SAN (IP-SAN), content-addressed storage (CAS), and storage virtualization.

Section 3, "Business Continuity and Replication": Four chapters introduce business continuity, backup and recovery, local data replication, and remote data replication.

Section 4, "Security and Administration": Two chapters cover storage security and storage infrastructure monitoring and management.

The book’s supplementary web site provides up-to-date information on additional learning aids and storage certification opportunities.
translatedDescription:
El crecimiento en espiral de la información digital hace que el libro ISM sea un "debido" además de su biblioteca de referencia IT. Este crecimiento exponencial ha impulsado la tecnología de gestión de la información a nuevos niveles de sofisticación y complejidad, exponiendo una brecha de habilidades que desafia tanto a los administradores de TI como a los profesionales. El libro ISM, escrito por profesionales de almacenamiento de EMC Corporation, adopta un enfoque ‘abierto’ para enseñar almacenamiento y gestión de la información, centrándose en conceptos y principios – más bien en específicos del producto – que se pueden aplicar en todos los entornos IT

El libro permite a los profesionales, estudiantes, profesores, ya existentes y aspirantes, y a aquellos que simplemente deseen obtener una visión más profunda de este nuevo pilar de infraestructura de TI para lograr una comprensión completa de todos los segmentos de la tecnología de almacenamiento de información.

Dieciséis capítulos se organizan en cuatro secciones. Los temas avanzados se basan en los temas aprendidos en capítulos anteriores.

Sección 1, "Depósito de información y gestión para el mundo actual": Cuatro capítulos cubren el crecimiento y los desafíos de la información, definen un sistema de almacenamiento y su entorno, revisan la evolución de la tecnología de almacenamiento e introducen sistemas de almacenamiento inteligentes.

Sección 2, "Opciones de almacenamiento y protocolos": Seis capítulos cubren la arquitectura del canal SCSI y Fibre, almacenamiento adjunto directo (DAS), redes de área de almacenamiento (SAN), almacenamiento adjunto a la red (NAS), Protocolo de Internet SAN (IP-SAN), almacenamiento equipado con contenido (CAS) y virtualización de almacenamiento.

Sección 3, "Continuidad y Replicación de Negocios": Cuatro capítulos introducen continuidad de las operaciones, respaldo y recuperación, replicación de datos locales y replicación remota de datos.

Sección 4, "Seguridad y Administración": Dos capítulos abarcan la vigilancia y gestión de la infraestructura de almacenamiento y seguridad.

El sitio web complementario del libro proporciona información actualizada sobre ayudas de aprendizaje adicionales y oportunidades de certificación de almacenamiento.

title: Designing Storage Area Networks: A Practical Reference for Implementing Fibre Channel and IP SANs, Second Edition
description:
Designing Storage Area Networks, Second Edition, succinctly captures the key technologies that are driving the storage networking industry. Tom Clark's works are helping to educate the IT community to the benefits and challenges of shared storage and are recommended reading for anyone wishing to understand this exciting new technology."

—Sheila Childs, VP Product Management, Legato Systems Chairperson, SNIA

Fibre Channel SANs have become a mainstay at the backend of the biggest corporations on the planet. The second edition of Designing Storage Area Networks brings the next wave of connection (IP) points and management into context, helping the user to quickly understand all the benefits before them."

—Steve Duplessie, Founder and Senior Analyst, Enterprise Storage Group

Designing Storage Area Networks, Second Edition, provides a practical roadmap through the ever-changing landscape of SAN technology. The new Fibre Channel, IP, and virtualization initiatives covered in this work will enable customers to implement comprehensive shared storage solutions that reduce management overhead and cost."

—John Webster, Founder and SeniorAnalyst, Data Mobility Group

Storage Area Networks (SANs) are now recognized as the preferred solution for fulfilling institutions' and enterprises' critical data-storage needs. Whether powered by Fibre Channel or TCP/IP and Gigabit Ethernet technology, SANs far exceed the capabilities of traditional storage access methods. SANs are quickly becoming the solution of choice for organizations that require high-volume data-handling capacity.

Written for network developers, IT consultants, administrators, and managers, this updated and greatly expanded edition of the best-selling Designing Storage Area Networks goes far beyond a straight description of technical specifications and standards. The text offers practical guidelines for using diverse SAN technologies to solve existing networking problems in large-scale corporate networks. With this book you will learn how the technologies work and how to organize their components into an effective, scalable design. In doing so, you will discover today's best methods for managing storage area networks, including new troubleshooting techniques.

Designing Storage Area Networks, Second Edition, also features detailed case studies that demonstrate how SANs can solve a number of commonly encountered business challenges, including LAN-free and server-free tape backup, server clustering, and disaster recovery. As an information-systems professional, you must keep pace with this powerful, evolving technology.

Key topic coverage includes:

Using the SNIA Shared Storage Model

Fibre Channel layers and protocols

Fabrics and fabric switches

Host bus adapters

Fibre Channel RAID and Fibre Channel JBODs

iSCSI and IP storage protocols and products

SAN management and problem isolation techniques

Building extended SANs for data center and remote storage access

SANs se están convirtiendo rápidamente en la solución de opciones para organizaciones que requieren una capacidad de gestión de datos de alto volumen.

Como profesional de sistemas de información, debe seguir el ritmo de esta poderosa y cambiante tecnología.

title: Accepted!
description:
Now a USA Today and Publishers Weekly bestseller!

How do you REALLY get accepted to Harvard, Yale, and the Ivy League?

Told from the fresh and personal perspective of 26-year-old Crimson Education CEO and Harvard, Stanford, and Oxford graduate Jamie Beaton, Accepted! is an honest and practical guide on beating the odds and getting into Ivy League and other elite schools – the smart way.

Beaton takes you behind the doors of the world's top college admissions offices, revealing the highly strategic selection processes applied by institutions whose reputations depend on the number of students they admit, or more pointedly, the tens of thousands that they don't.

In Accepted!, Beaton delivers the ultimate insider "how to" and disrupts cliched admissions advice with savvy strategies like:

Moneyballing the university rankings and increasing your chances of admission
Class spamming your way to academic supremacy and acceptance
Playing the early application dating game and understanding how institutions are using it to their reputational advantage

Packed with real-life examples from the thousands of students Beaton has helped land a spot at Harvard, Stanford, and other esteemed universities, Accepted! is a never-before assembled culmination of secrets, insights, and application strategies guaranteed to maximize your chances of "getting in" to the school of your choice.

From ambitious students and their supportive parents to academic advisors and admissions professionals, Accepted! is the must-read guide to demystifying the often-convoluted and increasingly competitive world of elite college admissions.

Moneyballing the university rankings and increasing your chances of admission

title: HTML, XHTML, and CSS Bible, Fifth Edition
description:
An essential update to the key web authoring standards of HTML, XHTML, and CSS

The existence of Web pages depends on three vital technologies: HTML (base language that Web pages are written in), XHTML (standards that define how to write HTML pages), and CSS (standard that applies formatting styles to Web pages). This new edition provides you with critical coverage of these three Web authoring standards, and places special focus on the upcoming releases of HTML 5 and CSS 3.

Serving as a tutorial and reference, this comprehensive resource explains the basic structure and necessary formatting to create a static (non-changing) and dynamic (changing) page on the Internet.

HTML, XHTML, and CSS are the three major Web authoring standards for creating either a static or dynamic Web page

Guides you through using HTML to create Web documents and introduces updates to HTML 5

Demonstrates best practices for using tools and utilities to create Web documents

Includes coverage of the new CSS 3 and tips and tricks for maximizing its abilities

Helpful examples round out this essential guide and will get you up and running with HTML, XHMTL, and CSS in no time!

Esta nueva edición le proporciona una cobertura crítica de estos tres estándares de autoría web, y pone especial énfasis en las próximas versiones de HTML 5 y CSS 3.

title: The Essential Guide to HTML5: Using Games to Learn HTML5 and JavaScript
description:
Gain a deep, practical knowledge of HTML and JavaScript that will provide an introduction to programming and enable you to build interactive websites. This completely updated second edition explains HTML, JavaScript and CSS in the context of working examples and contains full-color screen shots of the programs in action.

You'll begin at an introductory level, learning the essentials of HTML5 and JavaScript and programming techniques. Each chapter features either a familiar game such as Hangman, Rock-Paper-Scissors, Craps, Memory, and Blackjack, or a simple type of game, such as a quiz, a maze, or animated simulations. You’ll develop solid programming skills that will help when learning other programming languages. Each chapter contains tables revealing the structure of the program with comments for each line of code.

These examples demonstrate the features introduced with HTML5.  You’ll see how to use canvas elements for line drawing. You can include your own audio and video clips, directly controlled by your JavaScript code. For example, the reward for correct completion of a quiz can be the playing of an audio clip and a video clip. You’ll also learn how to use localStorage to store high scores or game preferences on a user's computer for retrieval next time they play. The Essential Guide to HTML5 explores all of this and more.

What You'll Learn

Understand HTML 5 concepts with the help of easy-to-grasp, appealing examples
Use HTML5 to explore new avenues for application and game development on the web
Review important new elements of HTML 5
Build, test, and upload simple games to a web site. 

Who This Book Is For

Both absolute beginners and users with some knowledge of HTML who want to learn the new HTML5 features

Esta segunda edición completamente actualizada explica HTML, JavaScript y CSS en el contexto de ejemplos de trabajo y contiene imágenes de pantalla completa de los programas en acción.

Comenzarás a nivel introductorio, aprendiendo lo esencial de HTML5 y JavaScript y técnicas de programación. Cada capítulo cuenta con un juego familiar como Hangman, Rock-Paper-Scissors, Craps, Memory y Blackjack, o un tipo simple de juego, como una prueba, un laberinto o simulaciones animadas. Desarrollará habilidades de programación sólidas que ayudarán al aprender otros idiomas de programación. Cada capítulo contiene tablas que revelan la estructura del programa con comentarios para cada línea de código.

Estos ejemplos demuestran las características introducidas con HTML5. Verás cómo utilizar elementos de tela para el dibujo de líneas. Puede incluir sus propios clips de audio y vídeo, controlados directamente por su código JavaScript. Por ejemplo, la recompensa por la correcta terminación de un cuestionario puede ser la reproducción de un clip de audio y un clip de vídeo. También aprenderá a utilizar localStorage para almacenar altas puntuaciones o preferencias de juego en el ordenador de un usuario para su recuperación la próxima vez que jueguen. La Guía Esencial del HTML5 explora todo esto y más.

Lo que aprenderás

Entender conceptos HTML 5 con la ayuda de ejemplos fáciles de hacer, atractivos
Utilice HTML5 para explorar nuevas vías para el desarrollo de aplicaciones y juegos en la web
Revise nuevos elementos importantes del HTML 5
Construir, probar y subir juegos simples a un sitio web.

Tanto principiantes absolutos como usuarios con algún conocimiento de HTML que quieren aprender las nuevas características HTML5

title: Mesh Adaptation for Computational Fluid Dynamics, Volume 2
description:
Simulation technology, and computational fluid dynamics (CFD) in particular, is essential in the search for solutions to the modern challenges faced by humanity. Revolutions in CFD over the last decade include the use of unstructured meshes, permitting the modeling of any 3D geometry. New frontiers point to mesh adaptation, allowing not only seamless meshing (for the engineer) but also simulation certification for safer products and risk prediction.

Mesh Adaptation for Computational Dynamics 2 is the second of two volumes and introduces topics including optimal control formulation, minimizing a goal function, and extending the steady algorithm to unsteady physics. Also covered are multi-rate strategies, steady inviscid flows in aeronautics and an extension to viscous flows.

This book will be useful to anybody interested in mesh adaptation pertaining to CFD, especially researchers, teachers and students.
translatedDescription:
La tecnología de simulación, y la dinámica de fluidos computacionales (CFD), en particular, es esencial en la búsqueda de soluciones a los desafíos modernos que enfrenta la humanidad. Las revoluciones del CDF en la última década incluyen el uso de mallas no estructuradas, permitiendo el modelado de cualquier geometría 3D. Nuevas fronteras apuntan a la adaptación de la malla, permitiendo no sólo la fusión sin costura (para el ingeniero) sino también la certificación de simulación para productos más seguros y la predicción del riesgo.

Mesh Adaptation for Computational Dynamics 2 es el segundo de dos volúmenes e introduce temas incluyendo la formulación de control óptima, minimizando una función de meta, y extendiendo el algoritmo constante a la física inestable. También están cubiertas las estrategias de múltiples tipos, los flujos invisivos constantes en la aeronáutica y una extensión a los flujos viscosos.

Este libro será útil para cualquier persona interesada en la adaptación de malla perteneciente al CDF, especialmente investigadores, maestros y estudiantes.

title: Pro HTML5 Games
description:
Build your next game on a bigger scale with Pro HTML5 Games. This book teaches you the essentials of advanced game programming in HTML5. You'll learn techniques that you can transfer to any area of HTML5 game development to make your own professional HTML5 games!

Led by an expert game programmer, you'll build two complete games in HTML5: a strategy puzzle game based on the Box2d physics engine and in the style of Angry Birds and a real-time strategy (RTS) game complete with units, buildings, path-finding, artificial intelligence, and multiplayer support. In the process, you'll learn how to do the following:

Create realistic physics in your game by incorporating the Box2d physics engine

Design large worlds with lots of characters and let users interact with them

Use sprite sheets, panning, parallax scrolling, and sound effects to build a more polished game

Incorporate pathfinding and steering to help characters navigate through your world

Create challenging levels with intelligent enemies by using decision trees, state machines, and scripted events

Add multiplayer in your games using Node.js and the WebSocket API

This book will help you take your HTML5/JavaScript programming experience to the next level. It gives you the knowledge and skills you need to develop more complex, bolder games and become an HTML5 games pro.

What you'll learn

Creating realistic physics in your game by incorporating the Box2d physics engine

Designing large worlds with lots of characters and let users interact with them

Using sprite sheets, panning, parallax scrolling, and sound effects to build a more polished game

Incorporating pathfinding and steering to help characters navigate through your world

Creating challenging levels with intelligent enemies by using decision trees, state machines, and scripted events

Adding multiplayer in your games using Node.js and the WebSocket API

Who this book is for

Pro HTML5 Games is meant for programmers who already have some HTML and JavaScript programming experience and who now want to learn to harness the power of HTML5 to build amazing-looking games but don't know where to begin.

Readers who have experience making games in other languages such as Flash and would like to move to HTML5 will also find a lot of useful information in this book.

If you do not feel confident about your game programming skills, don't worry. This book covers all the essentials needed to build these games so you can follow along and learn to design large, professional games in HTML5. The book will also point to resources and reference material for supplemental learning in case you are having trouble keeping up.

With dedicated chapters on HTML5 basics, the Box2D engine, pathfinding and steering, combat and effective enemy AI, and multiplayer using Node.JS with WebSockets, you should get a lot from this book no matter how much game programming experience you have.

title: Mastering FreeBSD and OpenBSD Security
description: FreeBSD and OpenBSD are increasingly gaining traction in educational institutions, non-profits, and corporations worldwide because they provide significant security advantages over Linux. Although a lot can be said for the robustness, clean organization, and stability of the BSD operating systems, security is one of the main reasons system administrators use these two platforms.There are plenty of books to help you get a FreeBSD or OpenBSD system off the ground, and all of them touch on security to some extent, usually dedicating a chapter to the subject. But, as security is commonly named as the key concern for today's system administrators, a single chapter on the subject can't provide the depth of information you need to keep your systems secure.FreeBSD and OpenBSD are rife with security "building blocks" that you can put to use, and Mastering FreeBSD and OpenBSD Security shows you how. Both operating systems have kernel options and filesystem features that go well beyond traditional Unix permissions and controls. This power and flexibility is valuable, but the colossal range of possibilities need to be tackled one step at a time. This book walks you through the installation of a hardened operating system, the installation and configuration of critical services, and ongoing maintenance of your FreeBSD and OpenBSD systems.Using an application-specific approach that builds on your existing knowledge, the book provides sound technical information on FreeBSD and Open-BSD security with plenty of real-world examples to help you configure and deploy a secure system. By imparting a solid technical foundation as well as practical know-how, it enables administrators to push their server's security to the next level. Even administrators in other environments--like Linux and Solaris--can find useful paradigms to emulate.Written by security professionals with two decades of operating system experience, Mastering FreeBSD and OpenBSD Security features broad and deep explanations of how how to secure your most critical systems. Where other books on BSD systems help you achieve functionality, this book will help you more thoroughly secure your deployments.
translatedDescription: FreeBSD y OpenBSD están ganando cada vez más atracción en instituciones educativas, sin fines de lucro y corporaciones de todo el mundo porque ofrecen importantes ventajas de seguridad sobre Linux. Aunque se puede decir mucho por la robustez, organización limpia y estabilidad de los sistemas operativos BSD, la seguridad es una de las principales razones por las que los administradores del sistema utilizan estas dos plataformas. Hay muchos libros para ayudarle a conseguir un sistema FreeBSD o OpenBSD fuera del suelo, y todos ellos tocan la seguridad en cierta medida, por lo general dedicando un capítulo al tema. Pero, como la seguridad se llama comúnmente como la preocupación clave para los administradores del sistema de hoy, un solo capítulo sobre el tema no puede proporcionar la profundidad de la información que necesita para mantener sus sistemas seguros. FreeBSD y OpenBSD son rife con los "bloques de construcción" de seguridad que puedes usar, y Mastering FreeBSD y OpenBSD Security te muestra cómo. Ambos sistemas operativos tienen opciones de núcleo y características de sistema de archivos que van más allá de los permisos y controles tradicionales de Unix. Este poder y flexibilidad es valioso, pero la gama colosal de posibilidades debe ser abordada un paso a la vez. Este libro lo lleva a través de la instalación de un sistema operativo endurecido, la instalación y configuración de servicios críticos y el mantenimiento continuo de sus sistemas FreeBSD y OpenBSD. Utilizando un enfoque específico de aplicaciones que se basa en su conocimiento existente, el libro proporciona información técnica sólida sobre la seguridad de FreeBSD y Open-BSD con muchos ejemplos reales para ayudarle a configurar e implementar un sistema seguro. Al impartir una sólida base técnica, así como conocimientos prácticos, permite a los administradores empujar la seguridad de su servidor al siguiente nivel. Incluso los administradores de otros entornos, como Linux y Solaris, pueden encontrar paradigmas útiles para emular. Escrito por profesionales de seguridad con dos décadas de experiencia en el sistema operativo, Mastering FreeBSD y OpenBSD Security ofrece explicaciones amplias y profundas de cómo asegurar sus sistemas más críticos. Cuando otros libros sobre sistemas BSD le ayudan a conseguir funcionalidad, este libro le ayudará a asegurar más a fondo sus implementaciones.

title: Pro Git
description: Programmers or project leaders will learn to use Git, the version control system developed by Linus Torvalds for Linux kernel development. You'll discover the world of distributed version control and learn how to build a Git development workflow, with expert guidance from Scott Chacon.
translatedDescription: Los programadores o líderes del proyecto aprenderán a utilizar Git, el sistema de control de versiones desarrollado por Linus Torvalds para el desarrollo del kernel de Linux. Usted descubrirá el mundo del control de versiones distribuidas y aprenderá a construir un flujo de trabajo de desarrollo Git, con guía experta de Scott Chacon.

title: Building an RPG with Unreal 4.x
description:
"Building an RPG with Unreal 4.x" is a guide to developing a turn-based RPG using the Unreal Engine 4. You'll learn how to combine programming in C with Blueprints to create game systems like combat, inventory, dialogue, and saving/loading data. This book is perfect for understanding essential game development techniques while building a fully functional RPG from scratch.

What this Book will help me do

Understand and program gameplay elements in C and Unreal Engine 4 workflows.
Design and implement systems for turn-based combat, inventory, and equipment.
Create reusable and efficient game data for RPG game characters and mechanics.
Develop practical skills in using Blueprints and designing user interface elements.
Learn to build save/load systems and other features necessary for complete RPG projects.

Author(s)

The authors, None Stagner and None Santello, are experienced game developers with a background in utilizing Unreal Engine for creating complex game architectures. They have a passion for sharing knowledge and have structured this book to be an approachable and hands-on guide, enabling readers to learn by applying concepts to real game projects.

Who is it for?

This book is ideal for aspiring game developers and hobbyist programmers with a basic grasp of Unreal Engine who wish to create RPGs. Readers should be familiar with the general concepts of RPG gameplay mechanics and have experience using game design tools. By following this guide, you'll be able to level up your development skills and bring your game ideas to life through Unreal.
translatedDescription:
"Construir un RPG con un 4.x irreal" es una guía para desarrollar un RPG basado en el giro utilizando el motor no real 4. Aprenderás a combinar la programación en C con Blueprints para crear sistemas de juego como combate, inventario, diálogo y datos de ahorro/carga. Este libro es perfecto para entender las técnicas esenciales de desarrollo del juego mientras que la construcción de un RPG totalmente funcional desde cero.

Lo que este libro me ayudará a hacer

Comprender y programar elementos de juego en los flujos de trabajo C y Unreal Engine 4.
Diseño e implementación de sistemas de combate, inventario y equipo basados en turnos.
Cree datos de juego reutilizables y eficientes para personajes y mecánicos de juegos RPG.
Desarrollar habilidades prácticas en el uso de planos y diseñar elementos de interfaz de usuario.
Aprende a construir sistemas de ahorro/carga y otras características necesarias para proyectos RPG completos.

Los autores, Ninguno Stagner y Ninguno Santello, son desarrolladores experimentados de juegos con un fondo en la utilización de Unreal Engine para crear complejas arquitecturas de juego. Tienen una pasión por compartir el conocimiento y han estructurado este libro para ser una guía accesible y práctica, permitiendo a los lectores aprender aplicando conceptos a proyectos de juego reales.

¿Para quién es?

Este libro es ideal para aspirantes a desarrolladores de juegos y programadores hobbyistas con una comprensión básica del motor irreal que desea crear RPGs. Los lectores deben estar familiarizados con los conceptos generales de la mecánica de juego RPG y tener experiencia utilizando herramientas de diseño de juegos. Al seguir esta guía, usted será capaz de nivelar sus habilidades de desarrollo y traer sus ideas de juego a la vida a través de Unreal.

title: Unity UI Cookbook
description:
Unity UI Cookbook is your hands-on guide for creating stunning and functional user interfaces for games using Unity. Throughout the book, you will master techniques for crafting UI components like counters, healthbars, and HUDs, all while integrating them with C scripts to make your games stand out.

What this Book will help me do

Master creating and managing counters and healthbars to display critical game information.
Learn to implement timers, format them effectively, and enhance time-based game mechanics.
Explore methods for animating UI components to build engaging and interactive experiences.
Understand how to design 3D UIs and minimaps to elevate game visuals and navigation.
Gain insights into implementing runtime customizations and advanced HUD designs.

Author(s)

None Sapio is a seasoned game developer with extensive experience in Unity and creating compelling game UIs. They focus on combining technical expertise with creative innovation, making complex topics accessible for developers. Through their practical guides, None aims to empower creators to enhance their game projects.

Who is it for?

This book is ideal for game developers who are familiar with Unity and C# and wish to elevate their skills in designing professional-quality UIs. Whether you are an intermediate coder or an advanced developer, the practical recipes provided will help you harness Unity's UI tools. If your goal is to build captivating and efficient interfaces for your games, this book caters to your aspirations and needs.

Unity UI Cookbook es su guía práctica para crear interfaces de usuario impresionantes y funcionales para juegos usando Unity. Master creando y administrando contadores y barras de salud para mostrar información crítica del juego.

title: Practical Video Game Bots: Automating Game Processes using C++, Python, and AutoIt
description:
Develop and use bots in video gaming to automate game processes and see possible ways to avoid this kind of automation. This book explains how bots can be very helpful in games such as multiplayer online games, both for training your character and for automating repetitious game processes in order to start a competition with human opponents much faster.

Some players might use bots for cheating or avoiding game rules to gain an advantage over opponents - a sophisticated form of hacking that includes some elements of artificial intelligence (AI). However, while Practical Video Game Bots considers these topics, it is not a cheater's guide. Rather, this book is an attempt to overcome the information vacuum regarding bot development in video game applications. Through the use of three case study game examples, it covers most methods and technologies that are used by bot developers, and the details of anti-cheating systems.  

This book provides answers and useful advice for topics such as process automation, reverse engineering, and network applications. Modern bot applications use technologies from all these domains. You will also consider the work mechanisms of different kinds of bots and will write simple prototypes.

What You Will Learn

Discover bots and apply them to game applications
Use clicker bots with OS-level embedding data, output-device capture, and more
Develop in-game bots, with process memory analysis and access
Work with out-game bots, with network interception and embedding data
Deal with input device emulation and OS-level interception data

Who This Book Is For

Those with some prior experience in game development and coding experience in Python, C++, and Windows APIs.
translatedDescription:
Desarrollar y utilizar bots en videojuegos para automatizar procesos de juego y ver posibles formas de evitar este tipo de automatización. Este libro explica cómo los bots pueden ser muy útiles en juegos como juegos multijugador en línea, tanto para entrenar su personaje como para automatizar procesos de juego repetitivos con el fin de iniciar una competencia con los oponentes humanos mucho más rápido.

Algunos jugadores podrían usar bots para engañar o evitar reglas de juego para ganar una ventaja sobre los oponentes - una forma sofisticada de piratería que incluye algunos elementos de inteligencia artificial (AI). Sin embargo, mientras que los Bots de video práctico consideran estos temas, no es la guía de un tramposo. Más bien, este libro es un intento de superar el vacío de información respecto al desarrollo de bot en aplicaciones de videojuegos. A través del uso de tres ejemplos de estudio de casos, cubre la mayoría de los métodos y tecnologías que son utilizados por los desarrolladores de bot, y los detalles de los sistemas anti-queating.

Este libro proporciona respuestas y consejos útiles para temas como automatización de procesos, ingeniería inversa y aplicaciones de red. Las aplicaciones de bot modernas utilizan tecnologías de todos estos dominios. También considerará los mecanismos de trabajo de diferentes tipos de bots y escribirá prototipos simples.

Qué aprenderás

Descubra bots y aplicarlos a aplicaciones de juego
Use bots de clicker con datos de incrustación de nivel OS, captura de dispositivos de salida y más
Desarrollar bots en el juego, con análisis de memoria de proceso y acceso
Trabajar con bots fuera del juego, con intercepción de red y datos de integración
Tratar con datos de emulación de dispositivos de entrada y de intercepción a nivel de OS

Quién es este libro

Aquellos con alguna experiencia previa en desarrollo de juegos y experiencia de codificación en Python, C++ y Windows APIs.

title: The Unofficial LEGO Builder's Guide (Now in Color!), 2nd Edition
description:
What's the difference between a tile and a plate? Why isn't it a good idea to stack bricks in columns to make a wall? How do you build a LEGO mosaic or build at different scales? You'll find the answers to these and other questions in The Unofficial LEGO Builder's Guide. Now in full color, this brand-new edition of a well-loved favorite will show you how to:

Construct models that won't fall apart
Choose the right pieces and substitute when needed
Build to micro, jumbo, and miniland scale
Make playable board games out of LEGO pieces
Create photo mosaics and curved sculptures
Build a miniature space shuttle, a minifig-sized train station, and more
Of course, the real fun of LEGO building lies in creating your own models—from choosing the subject to clicking that final brick into place. Learn how in The Unofficial LEGO Builder's Guide. Includes the Brickopedia, a visual dictionary of nearly 300 of the most commonly used LEGO elements!
translatedDescription:
¿Cuál es la diferencia entre una baldosa y un plato? ¿Por qué no es buena idea apilar ladrillos en columnas para hacer una pared? ¿Cómo construye un mosaico LEGO o construye a diferentes escalas? Encontrarás las respuestas a estas y otras preguntas en la Guía No oficial de LEGO Builder. Ahora a todo color, esta nueva edición de un favorito bien querido le mostrará cómo:

Construir modelos que no se desmoronarán
Elige las piezas adecuadas y sustituya cuando sea necesario
Construir a escala micro, jumbo y miniland
Hacer juegos de mesa jugables de piezas LEGO
Crear mosaicos de fotos y esculturas curvas
Construya un transbordador espacial en miniatura, una estación de tren de tamaño minifig y más
Por supuesto, la verdadera diversión del edificio LEGO radica en crear sus propios modelos, desde elegir el sujeto a hacer clic en ese ladrillo final en su lugar. Aprenda cómo en la Guía de LEGO no oficial. Incluye la Brickopedia, un diccionario visual de casi 300 de los elementos LEGO más utilizados!

title: Hiring & Firing (The Brian Tracy Success Library)
description:
Hiring and firing are hard to get right—and potentially costly to get wrong. Two of the most crucial tasks you face as a manager, they are vital to both the success of the enterprise…and your own career.

No need to worry. This handy guide breaks down the simple but powerful strategies you can use to bring better employees on board…and weed out the weaker ones. Featuring techniques that business expert Brian Tracy has identified as the most effective and that he himself employs, Hiring & Firing reveals how you can:

Write appealing and accurate job descriptions
Find suitable candidates
Use the Law of Three when interviewing
Ask the right questions
Probe past performance
Listen for the questions that indicate interviewees are qualified and serious
Dig deep when checking references
Negotiate salary
Start new employees off strong
Provide clear direction and regular feedback
Document performance problems
De-hire gracefully
Create an appropriate severance package
And more

Hiring and firing are key to improving your team and reaching your goals. This indispensable little book helps you eliminate the guesswork and make the best decisions for your business.

No te preocupes. Esta guía práctica descompone las estrategias simples pero poderosas que puedes usar para llevar a los mejores empleados a bordo... y despedaza los más débiles. Con técnicas que el experto en negocios Brian Tracy ha identificado como el más eficaz y que él mismo emplea, Contratar " Firing revela cómo usted puede:

Escribir atractivas descripciones de funciones y precisas
Encontrar candidatos adecuados
Use the Law of Three when interviewing
Haga las preguntas correctas
Probe rendimiento pasado
Escucha las preguntas que indican que los entrevistados están calificados y serios
Dig profunda al revisar las referencias
Salario de negociación

Y más

Contratar y disparar son clave para mejorar tu equipo y alcanzar tus objetivos. Este pequeño libro indispensable le ayuda a eliminar las adivinanzas y tomar las mejores decisiones para su negocio.

title: Unity Artificial Intelligence Programming - Fourth Edition
description:
Unity Artificial Intelligence Programming provides a comprehensive guide for integrating artificial intelligence into your Unity projects. By exploring the essential concepts like behavior trees, state machines, and navigation meshes, you will gain the skills to create smarter, more dynamic game characters and environments. Learn to utilize Unity's powerful tools, including machine learning techniques, to develop engaging and advanced game AI.

What this Book will help me do

Understand fundamental AI concepts for games and learn to implement them in Unity 2018.
Utilize automated movement techniques such as pathfinding and steering behaviors for characters.
Build efficient, interactive, and dynamic non-player character systems using Behavior Trees and FSMs.
Develop sensory systems and flocking algorithms to create realistic gameplay environments.
Apply modern machine learning methods to enhance in-game AI decision-making.

Author(s)

Dr. Davide Aversa is an experienced game AI researcher and developer, with a deep understanding of artificial intelligence implementation. Aung Sithu Kyaw brings his expertise in Unity development to the writing team, ensuring practical usability of techniques. Alongside their technical acumen, the authors present concepts clearly and practically for application in real-world scenarios.

Who is it for?

This book is tailored for Unity developers who have a foundational knowledge of C programming and the Unity Editor. It is perfect for aspiring developers eager to enhance their games with compelling AI-driven characters and systems. Whether new to programming AI in games or looking to refine existing knowledge, this book will guide readers to effectively implement game AI techniques.
